Wisdom 4 - Less wise, less understanding. You may struggle to relate with others, taking longer paths and more complicated solutions due to missing obvious alternatives. Mastering any kind of Ki would be very difficult.
Wisdom 5 - A typical amount of wisdom. You know what you like and don’t like, and from that, you can guess what others may like or not like.

Wisdom 6 - More wisdom than most, you can take on other peoples positions, including your future self, predicting and planning for what you want to happen. Sniffing out lies will be a little easier, and learning techniques of self-improvement will be easier as well.

Wisdom 7 - Your plans may remain the same, but your goals are improved, and your potential paths to achieve it are streamlined with a clarity of purpose and an understanding of the world around you. It will be very difficult to lie to you

Wisdom 8 - Understanding of the self and the world allows for influence over the self and the world. Monks who channel their focus and pursue enlightenment can push themselves in all areas, becoming stronger and faster than their bodies may otherwise allow.

Wisdom 9 - A sublime understanding of yourself and the world around you. There are monks sequestered on mountains, seeking enlightenment, who rarely reach this level of understanding and oneship with the world.

Wisdom 10 - The peak of mortal wisdom, that lets you understand the goals you have and the goals you should have. A perfected understanding of the self, the world, and the harmony of the two. Your soul is your own, leaving you immune to those who would manipulate it.

Wisdom 11 to 13 - The first step on the path of enlightenment and divinity. Understanding of the self unlocks new abilities and new paths, and many within the world (and some outside of it) will seek your opinion on how to improve themselves. You’ll be able to control your own internal bodily functions to some extent, redirecting energies into all of your endeavours.

Wisdom 14 to 16 - A smart person can engineer a way to divert whole rivers, yet it is said a wise person can divert it by placing a single stone in just the right place. Your wisdom and understanding allows for such feats of oneness with reality. Things like walking on water, stepping on air, or being immovable in the face of great force will all be possible.

Wisdom 17 to 19 - Reality and perception go hand in hand. Telling your body it is not sick or injured will be the first step in making it so, or redirecting energies from growing hair or nail into changing yourself, hardening skin and bone, or even seeking greater transformations and abilities.

Wisdom >20 - Stepping into the divine realms is simply a case of knowing where to place your feet. Your wisdom and intuitive knowledge leave everyone, including the gods, in awe and seeking your council as you reconceptualise problems with new perspectives, finding solutions that seem obvious with hindsight.
Charisma 6 or less: Unable to phrase your wisdom palatably, sharing it is more likely to anger others, resulting in few seeking out your advice, and fewer still acting upon it.
Charisma 8 or less: Unable to phrase your wisdom palatably, sharing it is more likely to anger others, resulting in few seeking out your advice, and fewer still acting upon it.
Charisma 10 or less: Unable to phrase your wisdom palatably, sharing it is more likely to anger others, resulting in few seeking out your advice, and fewer still acting upon it.

objects.title: Added Will
objects.text: The power of your character, your stubbornness, your defiance. Endurance doesn’t matter if you don’t have the heart to take a hit, and strength falls short without the courage to deliver the blow. This will also effects divine abilities, changing your strength of presence in the outer realms, where what is is decided by what you will it to be.

addons.text: Will 1 or less - You are a puppet without any will at all, hollow and controlled by whoever gives you orders. Your body is theirs, your mind is theirs: a toy or tool to be fought over and used.

Will 2 - Very little will of your own, resulting in you seeking out others to make decisions for you, even if they don’t have your best interests at heart. Choosing your own path will be very difficult.

Will 3 - You’re someone who cannot stand difficulty and hardships, always choosing the easier path in life. Making decisions or putting in the effort will be forever put on the back burner unless the situation absolutely requires it.

Will 4 - The below average will of someone who may be called a push over, yielding to the orders and suggestions of others with uncommon regularity. Particularly sensitive to mind control and quite conflict avoidant.
Will 5 - The average will of a person, swayed by the words of friend and foe alike, and adverse to hardship and pain.

Will 6 - Above average will. This could also be called ‘sales resistance’, leaving you a little more resolute in the face of opposition. This extends to mind control and other mental influence as well, giving some small measure of resistance to all persuasion.

Will 7 - The tempered will of a warrior or crusader, who can face hardships both physical and mental and come out the other side. Many combative religious orders train their people to this heightened level, giving them courage and conviction in the face of their enemies. Pain will be more bearable.

Will 8 - The level of religious leaders, and importantly clerics who channel advanced miracles of the outer realms. This will be needed to convince outer beings you don’t supplicate yourself to of your righteousness, or at least to stay somewhat out of your way. You can go on where most others would collapse from mental fatigue.

Will 9 - In a battle of wills, there are few who would not blink before you. That strength of personality and purpose can be instrumental in bringing people to your cause, or at least convincing them that you can actually pull off what you’re looking to achieve. Mind control will be near useless on you.

Will 10 - People of such strong will are impossibly rare, seen as a little bit mad, yet becoming beacons of focus in pursuit of their goal that can sweep other people along in their wake. Usually, it is only death that stops such people, and in a world of gods and undeath, sometimes not even that.

Will 11 to 13 - A will that can be considered inhuman. You could be a child saying you will fight god and win, and such will be the look in your eyes that some will catch themselves believing it. Beings from the outer realms, both ‘up’ and ‘down’, will pause to listen, and give your words credence.

Will 14 to 16 - Should you die with your work undone, you may return as an undead, if not already, crawling out of your grave to finish the job. Should you pray, you will be listened to, and you can brow-beat anyone, even some angels and demons, into doing what you tell them, simply for the asking. Pain will be outright ignorable.

Will 17 to 19 - Magic is technically a thing of will, whether its manipulation is from inside or outside of reality. With enough will, you have gained a form of magic resistance: the ability to tell the softer parts of reality to ‘not do that’ and be listened to. You gain an immunity of mind, with not even the most extreme situations breaking your sanity, and even regular reality will occasionally bend to your demands should it leave an obstacle in your way.

Will >20 - To stand in the divine realms is to be its new centre: a point so immovable that reality must move first. If you need a god to negotiate, they will. You may not get what you want, but the force of your personality is so great in the outer realms that they’ll give you something, even just to get you to leave them alone. Beware though, as nothing will stop your mission, even if you must be reduced to a raw vengeful ghost to complete it. You can become trapped between your will and your lacking abilities.

Wisdom 6 or less: Will accelerates you forward, but wisdom is the much needed breaks. Without it, you will be stubborn, pushing forwards and through obstacles that a wiser person would walk around, and ignoring advice that would help you toward your goals.

Wisdom 8 or less: Will accelerates you forward, but wisdom is the much needed breaks. Without it, you will be stubborn, pushing forwards and through obstacles that a wiser person would walk around, and ignoring advice that would help you toward your goals.

Wisdom 10 or less: Will accelerates you forward, but wisdom is the much needed breaks. Without it, you will be stubborn, pushing forwards and through obstacles that a wiser person would walk around, and ignoring advice that would help you toward your goals.

objects.title: Close Stat Increases
objects.text: Return to the choice of boons.

rows.title: Gifts For Yourself
rows.titleText:
What dream can be called good that does not engender the envy of others? And what life as well? Here you have the opportunity to grant yourself the greatness’s that can help you succeed; real, tangible blessings that can decorate your chest like medals, or shine in your eyes like reflected stars.

These will be tied to your body and your being and can be considered either rare or unheard of. They will give you an edge, no more ‘fair’ than the advantage gained by those born strong, or quick, or smart. They cannot be cultivated later, like skill and knowledge or bodily training, nor shed or forgotten or deactivated either, unless specified as such.

objects.title: Ageless Body
objects.text: A resistance to aging without the need to invest in Endurance. You will either remain at the age of your chosen body, or age into an adult body and stop, if reincarnated. This doesn’t give any other immunities or immortalities: you can definitely die, just not of old age.

addons.text: Endurance >16: By virtue of your stats, you already have this. Selecting it will give no added benefit.

objects.title: Regeneration
objects.text: Outside of typical endurance and its many enhancements to stamina and hardiness, the ability for even a pathetic weakling to knit themselves back together is available. You’ll be able to slowly and passively heal, similar to a troll, closing wounds and regrowing limbs with only a faint trace of a scar.

addons.text: Endurance >13: By virtue of your stats, you already regenerate, but this skill adds to it, increasing speed and efficiency to 2 endurance higher than usual.

objects.title: Flawless Skin
objects.text: This keeps you free not just of blemishes, cellulite, and imperfections of age, but also scars of all kinds, keeping your skin smooth and soft, no matter how hardened it becomes. It doesn’t necessarily increase your beauty, simply preserving what you already have.

addons.text: Regeneration: The scars that would otherwise come with regenerated flesh are not present, healed to untraceable perfection.

objects.title: Perfect Metabolism
objects.text: You no longer need to defecate or urinate, your bowels and body being divine in their efficiency. Vomiting will also cease, outside of expelling any large physical objects making ingress down your throat, and sicknesses will pass quickly, a small degree of poison and disease resistance granted also.

addons.text: Endurance >16: By virtue of your stats, the poison, disease, and sickness resistance here is irrelevant.

objects.title: Rebirth
objects.text: The chance for a second chance. While not immortality, dying needn’t be the end as you now have the ability to be revived in time. Years after, when your body has decayed, a garden will grow, with a new you at its centre. You can do this only as many times as this is purchased.

objects.title: Twisted Reincarnation
objects.text: Usually, death in this world, should it be true, will result in you joining its cycle of reincarnation. In time, you would be reborn into a new life as a blank slate, but with this, the slate needn’t be blank. You may choose to keep only one of two things: your past life’s powers, or its memories.

addons.text: You must make the choice now; whatever you choose will happen at each reincarnation going forward, should you fall.

objects.title: Inheritance
objects.text: Any children you may produce in the future will inherit any or all of the abilities selected now, be they fair or foul. It is yours to choose. This blessing will only convey half potency, and their children half again unless inbreeding, but it can result in a prolific and desirable bloodline.

objects.title: No Limits
objects.text: On its own, this does nothing, but it allows for endless growth unfettered by mortal limitations. Training your strength, you can start with the weight of a sword and build it up to the weight of a mountain. This will still take time and effort, and unlike a stat increase, your baseline remains the same.

objects.title: Animal Communication
objects.text: The ability to talk to the non-sentient animals of the world. They will speak truths to you, and while hardly erudite, they can be informative in a general sense. You can negotiate basic deals, asking them to spy for you, and even make friends if you’re persuasive. A ranger’s dream ability.

objects.title: More Bodies
objects.text: You would usually have only one body, one mind, and one soul, but with this you can spread out the first two several times, turning yourself into a hive mind of bodies. Your shared soul carries the keys, and duplicate minds only help to control your extra bodies; they don’t make you more intelligent.

addons.text: Should a body die, you will be able to revive it with powerful or continuous healing magic, or your own regenerative ability if you have it. So long as one body still exists, your soul will not move on and so they can revive unless completely destroyed.

objects.title: Power Theft
objects.text: Allows you to mimic the powers of others, should they be used against you. This works best against powerful individuals, but there are also limits; you can mimic a spell, but not understand it, meaning its original user will always have an advantage, and your ability to mimic will fade a day after first seeing it.

addons.text: No Limits: The ability to mimic what you see will not fade, but you must first recall the memory of what you saw, meaning you can retain the ability for so long as you have the memory. It may warp as the memory fades.

objects.title: Power Burst
objects.text: You can store up your power as a resource, unleashing it when needed. A days fragility and weakness can let you punch through a wall when you need to, and a week as a drooling idiot can give you the brains to solve a difficult problem. It’s all about balancing your shifting priorities.

addons.text: You’ll never get out more than you put in, and what you put in is neither unlimited nor perfectly balanced. A week with one less strength will give you 5 days with one more, and a single burst may be wasteful, never giving god like levels. You will retain a feeling of what you have and what you can do.
No Limits: You’re no longer limited in what you can store or use. Store strength and endurance for a year, then punch a crater in a mountain over a single second.

objects.title: Body Transformation
objects.text: The ability to transform your body, be it appearance, race, gender, or even species. This will be done without magic, being a somewhat slow and painful physical process that can be sped up with practice. You cannot change your age or heal yourself through this, outside of appearances.

addons.text: A shift in size take much longer to perform, and needs great food or a period of shedding to shift up and down. Any stat increases (or decreases) from changing form can only be by a single point; if you have the average strength of a man and take a few months to turn into a dragon, you’ll only be as strong as an above average man.
Ageless Body: You can change your age through this, growing older or younger, and getting all the pros and cons of such.

No Limits: You’re no longer limited in the increase (or decrease) of your stats, though the change still relates to your form. A dragon may be strong, but it cannot shatter mountains. A fox will be quick, but also pretty stupid. To stop you soft-locking yourself as a creature too dumb to turn back, there will be a minimum intelligence of 3, though this doesn’t raise your intelligence if you’re already mentally handicapped. While able to feign much higher stats than you have, remember that transformations are slow, and the dangers within the civilised world can be greater than outside of it.

objects.title: Flight
objects.text: You can fly, either using wings or a natural levitation. You can go as high as you can breathe, and as fast as you can sprint, which will depend on the dexterity you have. It won’t be as tiring, but don’t let wind and other forces blow you around like a kite: resisting such things requires strength.

addons.text: Harpy: You get this for free.
Wings: Reduces cost and takes you from gliding to fully flying. Requires some flapping to climb.

objects.title: Intangibility
objects.text: You can make some or all of your body intangible, passing through solid objects. Very powerful in basic combat or trespass, but beware of any opponent that uses magic or enchanted items as these will still effect you. Recommended you take flight, or keep your feet solid at all times. It’s a long way down.

objects.title: Teleportation
objects.text: The ability to move yourself from one place to another without magic. You must be able to see or have been to the place before. You can only take with you what you can carry, and there is a brief pause of concentration required that limits its utility in combat. Can be silent, with extra effort.

objects.title: Wealth
objects.text: Start with a considerable reserve of coin that you can will into existence, the equivalent of 10,000 gold. This hides away in a crack of reality, until you draw it forth, and once you take some out you cannot put it back in. Useful to have, until it runs out. Make sure no one find out about it.

objects.title: Beauty Attraction
objects.text: Those who join you, to be a friend or lover, or simply those who are caught in your orbit, are more likely to be physically attractive. This does not reduce the number of ugly people, but fate will stack the deck to place the better looking around you, especially among those friendly to you.

addons.text: Ugly or Below Average: Being surrounded by beauty while being ugly yourself will no doubt make life harder for you. Comparison can be a bitch.
Above Average: Being good looking while being surrounded by other good looking people will make you less able to stand out.
Beautiful: Being a beauty surrounded by good looking people will leave you the highlighted focal point for onlookers, but less distinct and singular than you’d otherwise be.

objects.title: Luck
objects.text: You carry good fortune with you. While never enough to win outright without effort, things will certainly go your way a lot more often, be it in the chaos of combat or the draw of cards in a friendly game. A gift best bestowed on the honest, lest people think you’re cheating.

objects.title: Pain Control
objects.text: You can decrease your ability to feel physical pain by choice, while retaining other more pleasant sensations. You’ll be able to lower pain incrementally, and raise it back to normal levels, all with a quick mental thought.

addons.text: Will >13: By virtue of your stats, you already have this, though selecting it will be the difference between ignoring and erasing the pain.

objects.title: Breathlessness
objects.text: You no longer need to breathe, though you can if you like, supping air to talk and sample scents at your leisure. Lacking the need, you cannot be drowned or strangled or gassed, and choosing not to breathe will come as naturally to you as breathing normally.

objects.title: Gift of Tongues
objects.text: There are many languages, of the world and beyond, some spoken and some lost to time. This will provide an inherent translation of all tongues, both in hearing and in speaking, allowing you to be understood by speakers of different languages at the same time.

addons.text: Know the Words: The originally chosen skill is ultimately superseded by this more general gift for language.

objects.title: Folded Space
objects.text: You will have within you a dimensional pocket from which you can store and extract inert, unloving items. While within this space, they will weigh nothing, and you’ll have the ability to store the spatial worth of a fully grown man before becoming slowed.

objects.title: Celestial Attainment
objects.text: Your celestial blood is of the rare strength to elevate your non-divine side. You will progressively become more angelic in form and mind, the comprehension of outer worlds becoming clearer. You’ll gradually become a divine being, with increased power, and treated as such by those who know.

objects.title: Less Sleep Needed
objects.text: What would usually be a healthy eight hours of sleep needed is now reduced to five or six. This brings with it none of the other fatigue reducing benefits of endurance, pertaining only to the sleep required to function optimally. This does mean you can go longer without sleep though.

addons.text: Endurance >10: By virtue of your stats, you already have this. Selecting it will give no added benefit.

objects.title: No Sleep Needed
objects.text: Sleep becomes optional for you, as while you can choose to give your mind a rest and drift off into whatever awaits you sleeping, you simply don’t need to. Sacrificing a point of vulnerability, and lengthening your days, may be critical to those who’d rush to the powers.

addons.text: Endurance >13: By virtue of your stats, you already have this. Selecting it will give no added benefit.

objects.title: Lucid Dreaming
objects.text: Whenever you sleep and dream, they will be lucid dreams of which you will have total control over and conscious awareness of. While still at the whims of errant thoughts, this can allow you to create any scenario you wish, though limited in accuracy by your own life experiences.

addons.text: You may not dream every night, and when you wake, the fantasy will be washed away, giving no persistence to your sleeping world. While just a fantasy, this gift is not without utility.

objects.title: Dreamworld Access
objects.text: An incredibly rare gift, and seen more as a curse; being able to enter the underlying dreamscape of reality carried significant danger, but can give you a connection to others, and insight into the inner workings of things. It is even possible to alter reality, albeit in way far less grand than you are now.

addons.text: The dreamworld is a twisted dark mirror of the real one, and contains the convention that maintains protections of the trophies. They will become hostile if learning you quest for them, but you may barter for details on the keys if you’re cunning, and learn esoteric knowledge about ancient history, inside and outside of reality.
Lucid Dreaming: The ability to lucid dream in the dream world is akin to magic in the waking one. It conveys a significant advantage, but you’re not invulnerable.

rows.title: Sexual Gifts
rows.titleText: With a sly unseen smile, you know there are more salacious gifts to give, to yourself, and through yourself, to others.

objects.title: More Sexual Stamina
objects.text: Separate and additive with regular stamina, this allows you to last longer in the bedroom, outlasting and outperforming most any partner. Where others would collapse gasping for breath, you can keep going. Works best with multiple partners, and any physical activity that involves sexual intercourse.

addons.text: Strong Orgasms: Balances out, leaving your mind blown and your body still going.
Endurance >12: By virtue of your stats, you will gain very little from this, but never nothing.

objects.title: No Refractory
objects.text: Sex becomes a meal in which you can always enjoy another course, yet are still satisfied with one. With this, the fatigue of sexual climax will be reduced to none, with only your physical endurance keeping you from any further rounds. Even your fluids will quickly replenish, with enough water.

objects.title: Tasty Fluids
objects.text: One way to convince others to give you oral sex. It will still taste distinct, with a discernible ‘you’ quality unmatched to any dish, but enjoyable on the tongue and matched to the taster’s preference. Also contributes to the general taste and smell of your crotch region.

objects.title: Addictive Fluids
objects.text: This applies to all the body fluids you possess, both sexual and in terms or spit, blood, and piss. All fun and games until you’re kidnapped by an addict and milked, or tasted by a vampire one too many times. The addition takes a while to build, but it’s moreish enough to ask for seconds.

objects.title: Sexual Situations
objects.text: Situations of an erotic nature happen more often around you. This does not turn the world into cheap erotica however; the lives this effects will be real. Infidelity, jealousy, accidental indecency, unwanted pregnancy, and obsessions, but also blossoming love, and yes, quick sexual trysts.

addons.text: It is not focused specifically at you, but you can be caught up in it, directly or indirectly. Expect the dramas of messy lives all around you.

objects.title: Clean Body
objects.text: Sweat and grime seems to slide off you, and every hole you have will be fresh an hour after use, either by you or by other people. You could leap into mud and it would fall away in minutes. Comes with a subtle fresh smell that will be quite pleasant for anyone with sharp scenes.

addons.text: Perfect Metabolism: You may not produce much in the way of your own filth, but this will help with other peoples should it get upon or inside you.

objects.title: No Periods
objects.text: None of the blood, none of the moods, none of the pain. No replacement menopause nor impact on your fertility. All the pros of an internal sex, with all the monthly inconveniences. There is magic and alchemy to help with this otherwise, but this will still leave you the envy of women everywhere.

objects.title: Pheromones
objects.text: A subconscious scent your body gives off that can affect the minds of civilised creatures. Makes others slightly more accepting of you by default, but has several modifiers that will be available in a new section.

rows.title: Pheromone Modifiers
rows.titleText: An imperceptible odour that makes others desire you slightly more and favour your wants and needs. Increases in potency the more you sweat, but rarely a game changer on its own. Ranges from nothing more than the greater chance of a friendly smile, up to an enemy choosing to save you for last. Can be modified below to increase or alter its effects.

objects.title: Friendly Only
objects.text: Removes the chance of people viewing you sexually due to your pheromones, even if you are their type and they yours. You’ll have to rely on your other charms for that. You’ll make fast friends though. So wholesome.

objects.title: Sexual Pheromones
objects.text: Rather than like you, people desire you, viewing you as a sexual object to win, want, or take. Still subtle, but expect more bottom pinches and crude suggestions, and smiles that want more than friendship.

objects.title: Rape Bait
objects.text: Many creatures who would wish to do you harm will now seek to use your body instead. A good way to stay alive, though there can be times when death is preferable. Don’t get captured; they’ll only let you go when your scent is smothered. If then.

objects.title: Pheromone Control
objects.text: You can turn your pheromones on and off, though it takes a short time to produce or dissipate. A powerful tool to tip things in your favour, both in and out of combat.

objects.title: Increased Production
objects.text: Smiles become open arms, holding doors open becomes games to win your favour, sparing you for last becomes keeping you alive for themselves. Increases all effects, good and bad. Sharp minds may grow suspicious in your absence.

addons.text: Pheromone Control: Can become a form of basic mind control and thus very powerful if used skilfully.
Rape Bait: Some may seek you out to satisfy their urges, so expect more unwanted encounters.
Sexual Only: The first thought in people’s minds will be to fuck you. The brave will ask. The unscrupulous won’t.

Friendly Only: You can become the instant centre of attention and charm all in attendance, even with that personality. With no chance of stalkers or rapists, this is truly the version without downsides.

objects.title: Close Gifts
objects.text: Return to the choice of boons.

rows.title: Immunities
rows.titleText: If you are to step into a dangerous world, with magic and spirits, demons and gods, and all the hostilities of unhealthy competition, you must harden yourself to survive. Some of these immunities may be also be achieved through enchanted items, potions, and spells, but being able to carry them with you, without thought, at all times, can be very useful. After all, often when you realise you need a defence against something, it is already too late.

objects.title: Poison Immunity
objects.text: Immunity to any and all poisons, whether applied by food, gas, magic, or stinger. It is as though it doesn’t exist to your body, surpassing the endurance usually needed for this.

addons.text: Endurance >16: By virtue of your stats, you are already poison immune.

objects.title: Disease Immunity
objects.text: Immunity to any and all diseases, whether from magic, undead, sexual interaction, or natural environmental spread, without the usual Endurance needed.

addons.text: Endurance >15: By virtue of your stats, you are already immune to disease.

objects.title: Mind Control Immunity
objects.text: Immunity to any and all mind control attempts, whether actioned through magic, pheromones, divine beauty, or insane persuasion, all without the usual Will needed to resist.

addons.text: Will >9: By virtue of your stats, you are already immune to mind control attempts.

objects.title: Soul Manipulation Immunity
objects.text: Immunity to any and all soul manipulation, whether from the undead, curses, or intervention from divine, infernal, or outer realm sources, all without the usual Wisdom needed.

addons.text: Wisdom >9: By virtue of your stats, you are already immune to soul manipulation.

objects.title: Temporal Immunity
objects.text: Immunity to any and all time manipulation. While extremely rare, the gods have been known to band together to change the past, and some angels can freeze time. If you desire power enough to challenge the heavens without claiming the powers themselves, you may need this.

objects.title: Spatial Immunity
objects.text: You cannot be teleported unless you want to be. Mages that use portals and teleportation, that either entrap or lock on to you, can no longer teleport you off a cliff. Despite how taxing it is for magic users, it is a fate all armoured warriors fear.

addons.text: Will >16: By virtue of your stats, you are already immune to spatial manipulation.

objects.title: Magic Resistance
objects.text: Spells will often fail unless you want them to succeed, or have their effects reduced. Curses will slide off you quickly and a cast effect will soon succumb to the entropy of reality. This is not immunity though, and magic can still do damage to you before being snuffed out.

addons.text: Will >16: By virtue of your stats, you are already resistant to magic, though this will add to that resilience.
Endurance >13: By virtue of your stats, you are already resistant to magic, though this will add to that resilience.

objects.title: Magic Immunity
objects.text: Unlike the others, this can be considered a disadvantage. Healing magic will fail on you, potions will do nothing, and enchantments are worthless, but the magic of mages and witches sputtering out in your presence is something witch hunters and anti-magic zealots would die for.

objects.title: Close Immunities
objects.text: Return to the choice of boons.

rows.title: Talent
rows.titleText:
Talent is neither skill nor knowledge nor even potential. After all, near all people have the potential to be a great swordsman, and can develop within themselves the skill and knowledge to become such. Talent, meanwhile, is a raw and undeveloped ability that can see a novice become a master in record time. It is a natural inclination towards something, that allows them to soak up lessons like a sponge, their innate understanding and predispositions giving them a tremendous advantage over others.

But beware, for it is a tragic circumstance, even in this new reality, that such aptitude is not always realised. The greatest mind of all time can die unremarked under a slave masters chains. Naturally inclined dancers can be born crippled, and the most powerful mage that never was simply lacked the mentorship of another. These talents will not help you when you walk into the world, but they can take a subject that would take decades to master and shorten the time considerably, letting you grow and stand above all others in the same field, with time.

objects.title: Offensive Combat
objects.text: You are inclined to the physicality’s of combat, having the ‘killer instinct’ to pursue on the offensive. While an instructor may chide that you left yourself open, they may be grumbling so from the ground, rubbing soar limbs and bruised ego.

objects.title: Defensive Combat
objects.text: How to adopt the most stable stance comes naturally, and it will take little instruction to perfect the best way to fight without getting hit. Perhaps your instructor would consider you too timid, but they would end the fight exhausted without scoring a blow.

addons.text: Offensive Combat: A natural talent for combat of all kinds. While you may begin not knowing how to throw a punch, it will only take a little training and experience before you’re showing other people how to fight like a decades long combat veteran.

objects.title: Stealth Ability
objects.text: You’ll have a natural talent for stealth, no matter your dexterity or perception. With a little experience, the intuitions that come to veteran sneaks, telling them who may be watching or what may be around the corner, will come to you decades sooner, and with work, you’ll surpass them sooner as well.

objects.title: Ki Potential
objects.text: The meditative skills of mind and body, born of wisdom, can take decades, even centuries to master. With this, such abilities come naturally, their oneness reflecting off the calm pool of your soul, their secrets quickly unlocked with guidance. Even without an instructor, this is something you could begin to unlock yourself.

objects.title: Divine Rejuvenation
objects.text: Your spirit is smiled upon by gods of renewal and return. Talented in the pursuit of healing, both in body and soul, and the channelling of divine light upon the disfavoured of the world, ‘healing’ it of both demon and undead. Such things will come to you as though by divine right.

objects.title: Divine Defence
objects.text: Your spirit is guarded by the divine sphere. Defending yourself and others comes to you with a natural ease, the gods of fortification, rebuttal, and comradery looking favourably upon you. Working with such miracles and learning their ways will be a thing of ease.

objects.title: Divine Wroth
objects.text: Your spirit is in tune with the divine sphere, where blessed holy beings of war and death reside. Channelling the techniques of destruction and rebuke comes easily, your spirit clearly favoured by the more destructive forces of the outer realm. Perhaps in you they see a kindred spirit.

objects.title: Prophecy
objects.text: Both a blessing and a curse, a talent where future events reveal themselves in dreams and in visions. Starting as ignorable dreams coming day or night, leaving only a sense of déjà vu, it is a gift that can be nurtured until it shows useful warnings of danger, or unseen paths towards new opportunities.

objects.title: Arcane Magic
objects.text: Magic as a fundamental; both the basics and the frontier. Arcane magic is the raw talent of the mind, and an aptitude for is proof of a mystic way of thinking. You’ll take to basic spell craft and the shaping of reality (both yours and other peoples) like water to an ocean.

objects.title: Elemental Magic
objects.text: Those who have a talent for the foundational building blocks of the universe. The flames, the wind, the waters, and the world, will all dance in your palm from the moment you’re taught to work them. Elementalists work the most direct and destructive forms of magic.

objects.title: Nature Magic
objects.text: The magic of the inhabited world, be it the plants, the animals, the changing of ways, or the cruel realities of mother nature. You will be green thumbed in this, as one with natures magic in both the good and the bad, and welcomed by the strong magic currents of the deepest darkest parts of Melliomer.

objects.title: Summoning Magic
objects.text: The bringing of things into the world, be they spirits, constructs, demons, undead, or thoughts from your own mind. You’ll be attuned to the pathways such things follow, a natural guide, acting as a waypoint in the fogged unreality between what is and what isn’t.

objects.title: Esoteric Magic
objects.text: Yours will be the expertise of the more mechanical and mathematical magics. The spells of twisting dimensions, painstakingly written glyphs, delicate touches, and constructed things that brim with enchantment. You’ll have a mind that finds the frustrations of such magics sweet to comprehend.

objects.title: Memory
objects.text: This is a talent for remembering, without the needed intelligence, expanding the vessel of your mind so that it may hold more without straining. This will not lock within you every mundane moment of your life, but it will make it easier to train yourself to recall details and to memorise information.

addons.text: Intelligence >10: You already have a wondrous memory, but this talent will help you to organise it better in time.

objects.title: Crafting Potential
objects.text: Tools fit into your hands like they belong, and what you make in your mind comes quickly and accurately to your touch. Whether weaving baskets and chipping stone, or enchanting armour that you’ve just forged, the physical art of creation comes to you with a natural ease.

objects.title: Wonderful Voice
objects.text: You may have never sung a note or told a single story, but you will poses a voice of hypnotic beauty that will make you a legend should you ever try. This will smooth all attempts of Charisma as well, leaving others wanting to listen to your voice, even if they disagree with your words.

objects.title: Talented
objects.text: A talent for, essentially, everything else. People with this rarely focus, trying their hand at all kinds of things and quickly becoming good at near all of them. The path of an unfocused jack of all trades perhaps, but it can help to provide new perspectives and opportunities to more focused talents.

objects.title: Close Talents
objects.text: Return to the choice of boons.

rows.title: Skills and Knowledge
rows.titleText:
From the moment you arrive, you will be able to perform these actions, the knowledge, skills, and even muscle memory placed within you. This is your starting line, placed quite a distance ahead of everyone else’s, giving you the abilities of someone who has studied the craft for about five years. This means knowledge, history, form, function, comprehension, and the results of experimentation, are all yours without any effort. 

It also means that with time, effort, inclination, and the proper training or opportunity, there is nothing here you cannot eventually learn yourself after you arrive. While these are skills that can be used straight away, they do not convey the natural talents of said skills, nor any inherent interest in them. This will also not make you anything more than proficient at your chosen skill, being carried past the threshold of a casual dabbler, but landing far short of a world renowned mastery.

Taking a skill you have a talent for will give you the same amount of learned time, but as you learn twice as fast with a talent, that means five years’ worth of skill will quickly become ten. Also, those who will begin their new life with a job will not inherit the skill to do it, and so choosing said skills here will help to blend in, boosted by the remnants of an inherited muscle memory.

objects.title: Combat
objects.text: The skills of fighting, killing, and surviving. Needed by some arrival types.

objects.title: Misc
objects.text: Skills of living, from thievery to homemaking. Good for earning coin.

objects.title: Ki
objects.text: The skills of wisdom based pursuits; meditation and the channelling of energy.

objects.title: Divine
objects.text: An understanding of the divine realm; the gods, their servants, and their power.

objects.title: Magic
objects.text: A comprehension of the magical arts; channelling the spells of many schools.

rows.title: Combat Skills
rows.titleText:
The knowledge of how to fight in various styles and forms and with various weapons types. Like with all skills, this is approximately five years of experience, and so while you may select the knowledge of one category of weapon, you’ll have studied many different examples within it. If you choose to have focused on one weapon or style within the category then you’ll be better at it.

As an example, if you choose to have an understanding of short weapons, you may either be ‘ok’ fighting with everything -be it sword, dagger, axe, or mace- or trade in that jack of all trades mentality to be really skilled with just scimitars.

Be careful should you plan to arrive in peril: you may not start with your preferred weapon in hand unless you’ve made the right choices.

objects.title: Long Melee
objects.text: Experience with spears, polearms, great axes, halberds, tridents, scythes, staffs, and large swords or maces; anything that requires two hands to wield with full effect and lets you hit your enemy before they hit you. Often best used in specific roles, but to an experienced user, it can fit any situation.

addons.text: Offensive Combat: You have a talent for this; long weapons will be wielded with more fluidity and familiarity.

objects.title: Short Melee
objects.text: You’ll have experience with typically one handed weapons, be they swords, maces, axes, picks, hammers, whips, rapiers, flails, or daggers. This is a broad category covering many weapons, so it’s mostly a familiarity with how you should move and strike one handed. Pick your specialisation.

addons.text: Offensive Combat: You have a talent for this; short weapons are natural tools in your hands and you’ll have a great amount of experience with them to go with it.

objects.title: Duel Wield Combat
objects.text: You’ll have considerable experience working with a weapon in each hand, keeping balance and maintaining both defence and offence at speed. It is experience enough to have ironed out the difficulties that end many who pursue this form of combat.

addons.text: Offensive Combat: You have a talent for this; like a juggler that can perform with their eyes closed, talent and experience make weapons more like extensions of your arms.

objects.title: Shield Combat
objects.text: You’ll know how to use a shield, blocking and anticipating blows, and even bating strikes when your defences are up. It’s recommended you take this with a melee option, be it sword or spear alongside your defences, but stranger combinations will at least catch people off guard.

addons.text: Defensive Combat: You have a talent for this; you’ll not just be blocking, but intuiting where strikes will come, even from the blind cover of your defences. People will wonder if it’s a supernatural ability.
Long Melee: You’ll be better able to balance a long spear and a shield with practiced ease, or use momentum and strength to wield great weapons one handed.

objects.title: Long Range
objects.text: This would be your javelins, your slings, as well as bows and crossbows of all kinds and styles. Gives you a familiarity with its handling, an experienced eye for judging distances and pulling off trick shots, and the ability to ready your next shot like you’ve done it a thousand times before.

objects.title: Short Range
objects.text: Still range, but with lighter weapons and shorter distances. This would be your throwing weapons, be they knives, darts, or stars, but also covers blowguns, caltrops, and alchemical bombs. Anything that can physically hit your target from a medium distance. It’s all in the wrists, apparently.

addons.text: Short Melee: You’ll be able to throw whatever is in your hands, be they swords and axes, or more specialised throwing weapons, like chakrams

objects.title: Hand to Hand
objects.text: Usually a thing for monks who strengthen the body, martial arts can leave your opponent disarmed, disorientated, or dead in short order if you can get close. This is something you’ll have considerable experience doing, without the brain damage that usually comes from training this.

addons.text: Offensive Combat: You have a talent for this; your fists will be hardened and fast, flowing with ease, and the usual counters can be bypassed with just as little effort.

objects.title: Combined Arms
objects.text: Magic and martial; the art of the battle mage. Few choose this path outside of Eardheart, but those who do possess unpredictable abilities on the battlefield, the combination of weapon type and spell type combined into one can leave an almost unique result.

addons.text: Requires a magic or divine skill be chosen, otherwise the speciality is magic annulment. Unlike other magic combat arts, this focuses on the balance between physical and magical attack, rather than the interplay.

objects.title: Armoured Combat
objects.text: The ability to move with armour on, how to wear it well, and how to both don and doff it quickly and easily, as though you have done so thousands of times. Covers anything from full plate to padded leather, and gives you the knowledge of how, when, and where to take a blow.

addons.text: Defensive Combat: You have a talent for this; people will comment that you move more fluidly in armour than out, and combined with your experience, you’ll be able to reduce any damage even further.

objects.title: Dodging
objects.text: The flexible skills of how to anticipate and avoid blows. Useful for those without armour, and usually trained quite painfully, balancing on logs while others throw things, or being blindfolded while other swing sticks at you. Requires some dexterity to make full use of it, but don’t discount experience.

addons.text: Defensive Combat: You have a talent for this; you’ll be like an oiled up snake, uncatchable, not just for your talent, but for understanding how others will try to stop you.

Armoured Combat: The skills of both moving and when to take a hit combine, the safety net of armour turning flips and overt acrobatics into the most efficient minor movements. Your opponent will near never leave a mark.

objects.title: Mounted Combat
objects.text: The knowledge of how to ride different mounts and fight from their backs, steering with your legs and balancing charges with attacks. Also gives the experience of working with animals, from putting them at ease to training them for use in combat. A good warhorse is a weapon all of its own.

objects.title: Close Combat Skills
objects.text: Return to the choice of skills and knowledge.

rows.title: Misc Skills
rows.titleText:
A collection of knowledge that stems from unhad experiences. Many are not formed of training, yet they can exist in your head all the same, floating around like some amnesiac dream, leaving only the knowing and the instincts born of it.

If you plan to arrive and step into the shoes of a complex job, the skills here will help you blend in.

objects.title: Tactics
objects.text: You are now a veteran of a hundred battles, with an understanding of how they’re won and lost, despite having not done either yourself. This covers knowledge you can be trained on, from books and history, as well as the experience of fighting, personally and in command.

addons.text: You can focus your experience, becoming more tactical one on one, or in schemes, or battlefield manoeuvres, or keeping a general tactical knowhow across the board. Scales with intelligence.

objects.title: Leadership
objects.text: Charisma may get people to listen and follow, but only through experience can you understand what it is you should tell them. The right commands, the right words, even the right preparation beforehand, deciding your command structure and signals. All are vital to good leadership.

objects.title: Lie Detection
objects.text: Perception can give you a lot of information about someone, and wisdom can help to interpret it, but picking up on the right social ques, facial tics and body language, is a skill anyone can take the time to learn. It’s not perfect on its own, but experience can be a deciding factor.

objects.title: Business
objects.text: The art of buying and selling, be it small scale or large. The skill and experience for that special kind of manipulation and sales technique, or a bigger pictures understanding; who sells cheap and who buys expensive, or what goods sell best with the seasons.

objects.title: Thievery
objects.text: The experience of a thief, without the prison time that comes with learning. The understanding of when to sneak and why, how to pick locks and pockets, what goods are worth the take, and a well cultivated prickle upon the back of your neck when someone is looking your way.

addons.text: Stealth Ability: You have a talent for this; remaining unseen while depriving others will come as easy to you as gold does to your pockets.

objects.title: Assassination
objects.text: An assassins skills, giving all the familiarity of blood on yours hands, without the actual blood. Unlike thievery, this covers poison knowledge, how to dispose of a body, the best path to vital organs, and how to slip into a crowd unnoticed. Helps in combat and countering assassins as well.

addons.text: Stealth Ability: You have a talent for this; killing undetected is a set of skills bolstered by your natural aptitude. You’ll be very good at it, and even better at getting away with it.

objects.title: Dancing
objects.text: Dexterity is important for grace and talent, but dancing so often means meeting others in the middle. Knowledge of the different kinds of dance, from different cultures that perceive different meanings, to the histories, to the easy confidence of simply having done it before.

objects.title: Singing
objects.text: From knowing the songs, the tunes, and how both differ between nations, to knowing how to prepare and care for your voice. How to project to the cheap seats and how to move and perform with uninterrupted grace. Skill and experience can give even a mediocre voice a passing grade.

addons.text: Wonderful Voice: You have a talent for this; a beautiful sound mastered and refined with skill and experience, leaving you able to hypnotise audiences with the best voice around.

objects.title: Crafting
objects.text: A broad set of experience. You can either be a complete jack of all trades, with a surface knowledge of everything, or you can focus on only one or two. Covers things like jewelcraft, fletching, carpentry, tailoring, and other mundane, saleable, or useful crafts you may be involved in.

addons.text: Crafting Potential: You have a talent for this; working with your hands is a habitual thing, and the skill you develop leaves you able to make great things with relatively little effort.

objects.title: Smithing
objects.text: A more focused skill, for its utility in adventure and its ubiquity among certain races. The knowledge of forging, repairing, and improving weapons and armours, and of course making goods like cutlery and barrel rings. It’s a skill that is highly respected among dwarves, and needed just about everywhere.

addons.text: Crafting Potential: You have a talent for this; forging metals and other material is an art of its own, and you are a master by experience and inclination.

objects.title: Alchemy
objects.text: Useful skills for adventurers, witches, and anyone looking to reshape the bounty of the world. Plant and animal parts can be reworked into potions that convey all kinds of benefits, be they cures, buffs, protections, contraception’s, drugs, or poisons. Favoured among the wilds and the elves of  Melliomer.

addons.text: Crafting Potential: You have a talent for this; the delicate balancing of alchemical properties is a blurred line between instinct and understanding. As a naturally great alchemist, you’ll be able to work well with ingredients you’ve never even seen before.

objects.title: Artistry
objects.text: Painting, drawing, sculpting, and any other expression of self, focused to one art or generally applied. These skills are hard won, and a sign of refinement, often adding flair elsewhere, such as crafting weapons and amour, or even golems and flashy spells of illusion and power.

addons.text: Crafting Potential: You have a talent for this; your style will write your name onto history if you let it, working your vision into all manner of mediums and letting pretentious people debate your inner thoughts for centuries to come.

objects.title: Homemaking
objects.text: Experience of managing a home, either in general or in specific. It could be the skills of a spouse raising children, or the cleaning skills of a talented servant, or the cooking skills of a chef, or the management skills of a household head. Cooking, cleaning, and tidying.

objects.title: Navigation
objects.text: On land or sea, the ability to look up at the stars to divine your location, or to read and understand animal paths, or feel where you are by the direction and temperature of the breeze, or any number of factors of skills and experience which let you know where you are and which way to go.

objects.title: Acting
objects.text: Or lying, if read less generously. Even the least charismatic person can learn to take on a role and improvise a dialog, though obviously charisma helps. The confidence to stand before a crowed and say things you know are not true, or even absurd, has utility for kings and criminals both.

objects.title: Adventuring
objects.text: A valuable skill if you seek the ultimate trophies, covering the wide array of knowledge you’ll need to survive. Things like tying ropes, identifying tracks, stocking provisions and counters to what you might find. Even things as simple as where and when to sleep when you’re on the road, or off it.

addons.text: Talented: As someone whose talents dabble in everything, you’ll be a true expert on all things adventure, with every situation working a little better for you than it would for another.

objects.title: Labouring
objects.text: Perhaps the broadest category there is, being ‘work’ that may hold no personal advantage beyond the work itself. Recommended if you are entering the world with a job, like a bureaucrat or dock worker, as this can give you the general knowledge of how to do it like the pro you should be.

addons.text: This doesn’t work if the job you have is covered with a skill above. i.e. if your ‘job’ is thieving then this will not give you thievery skills, though it may still convey surrounding details, such as local fences and gang navigation. The basic skills gained also don’t have to be for any job you have, but they cannot convey a significant advantage either.
Becoming Them: You already have the skills of your new life’s job and will gain nothing from this.

objects.title: Close Misc Skills
objects.text: Return to the choice of skills and knowledge.

rows.title: Ki Skills
rows.titleText:
A still and empty mind by nature is an illness; as alive as a barren desert, and half as interesting. It is only through emptying one’s mind by skill and knowledge, carefully sorting and organising it as part of the body, that it can become a cultivated garden, growing what you want, how you want.

Ki is a skill of wisdom, opening up learned techniques that grant control over your body’s own functions. These skills are developed and sought out by adherents: monks that spend many years unlocking such self-control. That said, such mysticisms can be practiced by anyone, offering a path to improvement and enlightenment to those who seek it.

As a result, all such skills can be learned, but all will scale with the wisdom you have. This simply allows you to know them without the years of meditation and introspection usually needed.

objects.title: Body Control
objects.text: A technique that unlocks paths of both sacrifice and gain. Falls that would break legs can now spread the damage more evenly, sicknesses that would linger for weeks can now be confronted and done in a hard day, and feats of great strength can be performed, accepting and minimising the muscles they tear.

objects.title: Body Understanding
objects.text: Knowing and listening to your body can provide a great deal of insight to those trained for it. Vague feelings become concise data, telling you just how hungry you are, how much longer you can go without water, your sleep levels, your arousal levels, precise temperatures and what a random pain actually means, among many other things.

objects.title: Body Connection
objects.text: A technique that allows those who know their own being to influence others, bringing them into harmony. If the practitioner is healthy, they can speed the healing of others. If they are calm, they can calm others, sharing resolve, and if they are harmed, they can share that harm as well. All it takes is a touch.

objects.title: Body Projection
objects.text: A more advanced form of the technique, mastered only by a few. It allow the abilities of body connection to be projected out among the spirits of those around you, allowing an unyielding leader to share their focus and clarity with all those around them that they would call friend. This can turn the tide of many battles.

objects.title: Battle Meditation
objects.text: A technique many warriors try to cultivate. Combat can be chaos, yet accepting your own place within it can help to shape and navigate the madness around you. Those who learn this are far more controlled and organised within the confusing maelstrom of battle, reducing panic and revealing new opportunities as a result.

objects.title: Trained Senses
objects.text: A state of oneness that allows you to shift energies towards your senses, hearing your opponents heartbeat, seeing the flick of their eyes, and sensing the shift of their weight. Unlike perception, this is a chosen focus: a meditative technique that requires a focused state and a cost of mental fatigue.

objects.title: Mental Dexterity
objects.text: A technique that involves learning a fluid dance like movement that, while of little physical use, can impart great mental agility in regards to opponents. Mind controllers will find practitioners slippery opponents, and can even be counter controlled, the technique the closest thing to a mental martial art there is.

objects.title: Training Improvement
objects.text: A technique that brings body and mind more into alignment, increasing the results of training by having one help the other more. Mental learning can be aided by redirecting energies from the body to the mind, and physical learning can use mental focus more effectively. Learning speed overall is increased.

objects.title: Iron Skin
objects.text: A technique that allows the channelling of energies into skin and bone, hardening both to the point that even blades can be deflected. Unlike endurance, this robustness is a learned technique, and must be actioned by will, like tensing a muscle; a must have for the best hand to hand fighters, letting them win against actual steel.

objects.title: Monk Fighting
objects.text: There are some monasteries and orders that focus on hand to hand fighting, though usually few in the parts you’re headed. These techniques utilise the full body in attack and defence, and its adherents can be very challenging opponents one on one. The fighting style you gain from this is up to you.

addons.text: Unlike typical hand to hand fighting that relies on strength, monk fighting is a mixture of strength and dexterity, bolstered with wisdom, with more technique and a far higher learning curve.

objects.title: Movement Casting
objects.text: With an understanding of your key internal points, you can effetely cast any magic you know through movement alone. While technically you could perform a complex ritual with a dance, it’s more commonly learned to throw fire with flaming feet, or doge by channelling the wind around you.

addons.text: Requires some divine or magic skills, though without either, it will provide some techniques of magic annulment. While it doesn’t require a physical combat skill, it would greatly benefit from it.

Combined Arms: You can fight much more effetely with magic and weapons, weaving spells with both your armaments and your body, using magic and the physical interchangeably. You opponent will never know when a spell is going to hit them.

objects.title: Channelled Casting
objects.text: Magic is typically a projection: an external thing that can wrap around you or another, or manipulate the world with changing intent. To a master of Ki though, the line between caster and spell can be much more blurred. They can hold a spells power within their own body, withstanding its force and unleashing its power with directed intensity.

addons.text: Requires some divine or magic skills. Fireballs can lead to burning fists, and healing spells to slow regeneration. Buffs upon yourself will be more powerful, and attacks upon your enemies more powerful as well, with the disadvantage that some physical contact is required to deliver them.

Movement Casting: Casting by moving and targeting yourself is the mark of a truly deadly magic caster. With the simple act of walking, you can bring fire about you and leave it in your steps, or radiate a holy light, or any other magic that may now seem effortless and brimming with power.

objects.title: Foresight
objects.text: It is possible, through long training and deep meditation, to be so connected to the universe that it will reveal some future knowledge. It is only by focusing upon a topic that small slivers of insight can be gained, and it requires a tremendous wisdom to understand the ever changing future.

addons.text: As with all skills, it can be balanced or focused as the learner wishes. From small intuitive knowledge that can provide a clear stream of future seconds in combat, to more long reaching and murky revelations.

Prophecy: The natural talents you poses can be focused and refined through Ki, allowing for more targeted visions of more distant events. This combination of talent and training is the first key ingredient of all great seers.

objects.title: Close Ki Skills
objects.text: Return to the choice of skills and knowledge.

rows.title: Divine Abilities
rows.titleText:
The skills of priests, clerics, paladins, and any who would pledge themselves to being of the divine outer sphere. While the knowledge that can be gained here is important, it is simply how to open the door through which your own will can be projected. 

While a humble temple initiate can blindly recite incantations of healing, more advanced practitioners can use their will to essentially browbeat lesser and even greater divine entities to do what they want them to, whether in specific or in result. In some respect, it is like taming natural forces. 

Be warned, the outer realms are divine, but divine does not mean benevolent. There are many forces of nature, and many gods, whose reach extends into places of heartache and regret. It will be up to you who you choose to work with, or for, or dominate the power thereof. This also extends to their followers. Like all skills, these can be learned in the world if not taken here, but you’ll have to deal with the fanatic to learn, and they may expect unconventional things from you in return.

objects.title: Healing Magic
objects.text: The most common prayers learned, and an expansive school because of that. From using divine magic to close wounds, cure poisons, and heal diseases, all the way up to rare and difficult rituals of resurrection. As with all divine magic, its effectiveness is determined by how much you want it.

addons.text: Divine Rejuvenation: You have a talent for this; you’ll be further ahead than your peers in experience and bedside manner.

objects.title: Light Divinities
objects.text: Knowledge of the benevolent reaches of the heavens, whose adherents are often practiced in holy magic that banishes evil or otherworldly forces, like demons and undead. In addition to attack magic, it can also inspire, reveal, shelter, and improve luck. The most popular religions primarily practice this, for obvious reasons.

addons.text: Divine Rejuvenation: You have a talent for this; your abilities against the undead and demonic will be bolstered by an instinctual understanding of what damages them the most.

objects.title: Soul Interventions
objects.text: Knowledge of souls, usually studied by exorcists to cleans ghosts, spirits, and the undead, but can also be used to heal, guard, or cause soul injuries. Can also be studded by necromancers to improve their abilities, but never as part of a religion; priests of souls usually focus on maintaining the natural order.

addons.text: Divine Rejuvenation: You have a talent for this; your innate skills expand your soul knowledge, making your voice and command to spirits more authoritative and clearer.

objects.title: Religious Knowledge
objects.text: The pantheon of the outer realms is vast, but the long years have left much of it charted. While some can pray to whoever is listening, knowing who to call can improve the effectiveness of any divine spell. This is also what a temple initiate will primarily be studying, before any miracles are made.

objects.title: Shielding
objects.text: Unlike blessings, shields are a more overt demonstration of ability, bringing walls of divine energy to stop people, weapons, magic, or forces of nature. Some can be cast around bodies, hugging them like armour, while some can block passages. Some glow with purifying light, or burn with retaliating strikes.

addons.text: Divine Defence: You have a talent for this; your ready understanding of shields increases, giving more strength and intricacies of shape than you contemporaries can muster.

objects.title: Divine Blessings
objects.text: True and permanent blessings are very rare, but temporary buffs to either yourself or those around you can quickly move your party from being outclassed to outclassing. Such prayers can be focused on an individual or upon a large group, and can increase their abilities or offer resistances.

addons.text: Divine Defence: You have a talent for this; the blessings you can bring upon yourself and your allies are increased significantly, in strength and number.

objects.title: Spirit Contracting
objects.text: While some may contract demons, who always want more than they give, divine casters can contract with more benign or benevolent beings, such as spirits of nature, godly servants, or even the honourable dead. They’ll work and fight for you, and can be very powerful, the only issue being managing their expectations.

addons.text: Divine Defence: You have a talent for this; the divine allies you can bring to your side will be more powerful, your relationships with them more solid as understanding meets experience.

objects.title: Great Ritual
objects.text: Closely guarded rituals and miracles are now known to you, allowing you to perform ceremonies to bring about the most direct interventions of the gods. These usually require some great sacrifice, or involve labours of pain or humiliation, or feats of endurance, but this can lead to permanent boons, or items of power.

addons.text: These rituals usually require knowledge of the various gods, or expertise in one or more different types of divine magic, for you to perform rituals. Mastery of curses could let you curse a city, while spirit contracting could summon an angel to be you companion etc.

objects.title: Dark Divinities
objects.text: Knowledge of safely beseeching the darker elements of the divine: gods of night, sickness, poisons, plots, and obfuscations. Favoured by religious assassins, this can help to move and kill silently, or to directly attack your opponents with malignant corrupting energies. Covers many cruel and feared rituals and interventions.

addons.text: Divine Wroth: You have a talent for this; conjuring shadows to move through and strike from will come naturally, and your experience allows you to maximise the results of both attack and escape.

objects.title: Curse Knowledge
objects.text: Not all divine being want what is best for people; some specialise in bitter curses, and knowing how to beseech them can allow a practitioner to debuff their enemies in combat temporarily, or cast more brutal and longer lasting rituals that can cripple or kill from far away. Favoured by witches, and difficult to trace.

addons.text: This can give either general knowledge of curses, or more focused knowledge, such as long but powerful rituals, battle managing debuffs, or even counter cursing, curse breaking, and curse protection if following a more positive path.

Divine Wroth: You have a talent for this; your talents allow an understanding that can cheapen the cost of curses and speed their casting, the darker gods always happy to see their favoured curse bringer at work.

objects.title: Death Divinities
objects.text: Knowledge of the grey gods, who govern the cycles of life, death, and rebirth. Their miracles usually focus on improving the land, increasing crops in summer and rot in winter. While focused on balance, some specialise more in life’s bounties, and others on this magic’s entropic ability to kill and destroy.

addons.text: Divine Wroth: You have a talent for this; using divine magic to kill or manipulate life will come naturally and your skills will increase exponentially without the need for deadly experiments.

objects.title: Will Reversal
objects.text: While divine magic usually requires a strong will, it is possible to pursue a different and all too common path. Down the road of supplication, faith can be used to allow divine power to be channelled, supplanting will to a higher force. With this method, the less will you have, the stronger your miracles will be.

addons.text: You’ll likely never rise to be an independent hero; people who pursue this path are usually better off being support for others, as easily dominated by their party as they are by the gods.

objects.title: Close Divine Skills
objects.text: Return to the choice of skills and knowledge.

rows.title: Magic Schools
rows.titleText:
The place where knowledge is most sought after; magic can be broken down almost infinitely, from grand universal forces to the syllables and expressions of individual spells. Schools are broad terms to cover the groups of spells that often lend themselves toward each other, sharing incantations, glyphs, and fundamental philosophies. After all, the foundations of a ball of fire and a ray of fire are much the same, while a fireball and a dimensional manipulation are worlds apart.

For this pursuit, intelligence can carry you far, but channelling magic is a thing of mind and body and will. In the same way that knowing the technical elements of painting does not make you able to paint, it takes skill and practice to be able to cast magic, and thus the lessons you can gain here will save years of study, even for the highest intellect.

All these are schools that already exist. If you gain the knowledge of multiple, you may also gain the insight of how they can work together. They could also become platforms for schools of your own study, as all schools were formed by someone trying something new.

objects.title: Arcane Magic
objects.text: Also known as foundational or raw magic, yet some can spend their whole lives studying it. This allows for a wide verity of utility spells, as well as a good foundation for any magical education going forwards. From creating light and animating objects, to causing vast magical explosions and anomalies.

addons.text: Arcane Magic: You have a talent for this; your abilities with the basics of magic outstrip the abilities of more ‘advanced’ schools, allowing for more complex manipulations of reality, and proving that the height of skill truly depends on the depths of the foundations beneath it.

objects.title: Telekinesis
objects.text: The magical knowhow to move objects with your mind. This could be generally anything, even people, with your intelligence deciding how heavy the objects can be and how dexterous the control you have over them is. Weapons can be used, but you’ll need skill in the weapon to use it well.

addons.text: Arcane Magic: You have a talent for this; manipulating objects with your mind will come as easily as it would with your hands, allowing for a much more carefree and subtle skill.

objects.title: Mind Control
objects.text: Control over beasts and people via a domination of their will. This scales with intelligence and your own will, deciding how powerful of a mind you can control, how many, and for how long. Allows some rewriting of memories, both adding and deleting, but it would take a powerful caster to make such things permanent.

addons.text: Arcane Magic: You have a talent for this; wrapping minds around your will is an easy thing, with only the stronger minds giving any resistance. Beware though, as with great power comes great fear; no one will relish the thought of being controlled by you.

objects.title: Body Control
objects.text: This is a school that brings control over a person’s body: a far easier feat than control over their mind, and often just as effective. Focuses on techniques that immobilise and imprison a person either directly or via some containment, it was created by mage jailors, and perfected by less savoury types.

addons.text: Mind Control: You’ve mastered controlling other peoples bodies and minds, puppeteering them either with or without their knowledge. Includes some possession spells, splitting your mind of leaving your body asleep. Few opponents will be able to stand against you, save those without minds or bodies, such as the wild whims of chance and bad luck.

Arcane Magic: You have a talent for this; controlling the bodies of others will be easier and more subtle, immobilising individual limbs to puppeteer them, or paralysing them into strengthless heaps or rigid shapes of tensely held forms.

objects.title: Counter Spells
objects.text: The magical art of screwing up other peoples magical arts. This can be anything from a simple backfire cast on the fly against a rival mage, to the unravelling of long lasting enchantments, as well as magical traps and locks. Some witch hunters train in this, even if they shun other magic’s.

addons.text: Arcane Magic: You have a talent for this; where others weaken or disable spells, sparking them out like rain on a fire, you can outright take control, redirecting the magic where you please. This may mean catching fireballs and returning them to sender, or bypassing enchantments for yourself, but leaving them for others.

objects.title: Fire Casting
objects.text: Fire has been a long studied school of elemental magic, lauded for its destructive capabilities and its ‘quick to learn, hard to master’ nature. This is favoured by battlemages the world over, bringing burning flames, bursting explosions, and high priority targets to conflicts wherever they arise.

addons.text: Elemental Magic: You have a talent for this; the soft orange fires of other mages seem cold compared to the white hot fires you can muster, bringing melting destruction to what the talentless would only stain black with scorch.

objects.title: Air Casting
objects.text: An often invisible elemental magic, and thus requiring a more dexterous and fluid mind-set to master. From the obvious destructive gales that can blow man and building over, to more utilitarian uses, like transportation by sail, be it though sea or sky, or the clearing of clouds on overcast days.

addons.text: Elemental Magic: You have a talent for this; the wild wind that slips through the fingers of others can be gripped by you, either condensed to a brutal cutting force, or thinned, snuffing out fire and consciousness with its absence.

objects.title: Water Casting
objects.text: The study of elemental water magic. Novices can move and shape its flow, while advanced practitioners can conjure it as rain or river, using it to batter down, wear away, or even pressure solid objects, and to give opponents impromptu drownings.

addons.text: Elemental Magic: You have a talent for this; where others are limited to pure water, the master knows that all fluids are the same. Talent can also help to utilise the cooling power of water, forming difficult and deadly ice magic that gives a sharp edge to your flowing strikes.

objects.title: Ground Casting
objects.text: No elementalist shuns the advantages ground based magic can give, for a vast number of opponents fight upon the arena of its name. From moving rock and stone to shaping the very battlefield, all castles must be built to resist this, and the very best are built using it.

addons.text: Elemental Magic: You have a talent for this; rising rock and stone for defence and throwing it for attacks will come naturally, and even moving through the ground will be possible, the hardest rock now a swimmable surface to you.

objects.title: Lightning Casting
objects.text: Often seen as the pinnacle of destructive elemental magic, being the quicker and more destructive school, and the most frightening to be thrown at you. It is also among the newest, yet to be expanded into any purpose beyond destruction. An art waiting for more inventive students perhaps?

addons.text: Elemental Magic: You have a talent for this; while others throw wasteful lightning bolts that shatter the air, you can spark invisible electricity’s through opponents, killing with a touch that few understand. You also have a foundational understanding of static and electro magnetics, giving you a head start on truly expending this field of study.

objects.title: Poison Magic
objects.text: While of a nature school, poison magic is the art of disrupting beings by creating spells that get inside of their bodies and interfere with their normal functions, up to and including death. This means it’s a magic that can still effect creatures of limited internal function, such as undead.

addons.text: Nature Magic: You have a talent for this; more infectious diseases can be cast, and in more ways, be they invisible gas, or a touch, a trap. The effects of the poison are also more susceptible to your creativity, conveying drunken confusion, anger, or arousal.

objects.title: Nature Magic
objects.text: A broad school that works with all things existing in nature, from cultivating trees, to commanding animals, and even controlling natural healing and the weather.
