While the most expansive art, it is rare for a practitioner to dominate nature, each spell instead more like a complex negotiation, aided by charisma.

addons.text: Nature Magic: You have a talent for this; the flows of nature will bend to your will far more readily, going further out of its way to grow, attack, protect, and nourish you.

objects.title: Animal Transformation
objects.text: A nature magic that allows for the transformation of yourself and others into creatures of the natural world, either in part or in full. This only effects naturally occurring animals as it is an adoption of their spirit, though you can become the best example of them.

addons.text: Body Transformation: This allows using magic to aid your natural gift, greatly speeding up your transformations, limiting the loss of intelligence, and countering the food and sheading requirements that come with great changes in size.

Nature Magic: You have a talent for this; transforming is more like an art, allowing you the blend multiple animals together into a chimera, gaining the strength of each for as long as you can keep the spirits in unison. You can also adopt animal parts into your normal shape as well.

objects.title: Insectoid Magic
objects.text: A particularly repulsive school of nature magic, considered evil by most. Allows for the controlling and creation of insect swarms, and particularly of the corruption of self, allowing practitioners to gain or use power by consuming or rotting anything organic. Favoured by witches in Melliomers southern jungles and Nellacombs eastern reaches.

addons.text: Nature Magic: You have a talent for this; all things associated with rot come to your aid, including small creatures like rats, and even moulds and funguses. Sapping life and power from things becomes as easy as drinking water from a screaming cup.

objects.title: Voodoo Magic
objects.text: A form of cursing magic that relies on the stranger ties of natural connection over any godly influence. While only moderately useful in combat with its fear, numbing, and disorientations, it has the ability to strike others unseen from great distances away, at least with enough preparation, and is very hard to guard against.

addons.text: Curse Knowledge: Combining divine curses with magical manipulation allows you to shape what you can will forth from divine places. While considered even more profane than either practice alone, it is far more powerful and insidious.

Nature Magic: You have a talent for this; the nature forged bridge linking your pervasive influence to your target is all the stronger, and all the quicker, allowing faster cursing in combat. Outside of combat is where you really shine, letting you perform some truly wicked acts upon those in your power.

objects.title: Summoning
objects.text: The knowledge to bring forth creatures from worlds and locations neither divine nor infernal. Amalgamated spiritual forms, the slithering tentacled creatures of other worlds, and even fey you may bind yourself to. A school that works well with many others, such as Necromancy, Demonology, and Enchanting.

addons.text: Usually, summoners will partially summon something in a safe environment, make some deal with or otherwise assess it, and then summon it for real when they need it, but wild summoners exist. These bring forth creatures from bazar places, loyal to no one, simply pointing their rampage in the right direction. They are the result of many monsters, and not well liked because of it.

Summoning Magic: You have a talent for this; when it comes to making connections with things, they are more likely to understand and conform to your needs. A more natural understanding of tangential realities gives more options of things to summon.

objects.title: Necromancy
objects.text: The dreaded school of animating the dead and manipulating souls, this is a path to several forms of immortality, requiring quite a bit of prep work to use in battle. Works best hand in hand with divine knowledge and is favoured by the academy in the mountains of Highmarch.

addons.text: Soul Interventions: A staple for any necromancer that wishes to work with more than just flesh and bones; souls are used as a kind of spiritual lubricant in many powerful rituals and are required for things like immortality and improvement.

Death Divinities: A tedious topic to study usually, relating more to the cycles of natural processes, but knowledge of the divine spectrums of death will make you a significantly more deadly necromancer.
Summoning: Enhances the ability to bring forth and control ghosts and other scattered immaterial undead forms, and pierce the vail of the spiritual lands of the afterlife.
Summoning Magic: You have a talent for this; undead flesh seems eager to shift and come alive under your touch, and body parts themselves can become deadly weapons in your hands.

objects.title: Demonology
objects.text: The knowledge of summoning and dealing with demons, either binding them to your service or using them for your power, knowledge, or personal gratification. Such practitioners are never trusted, but their knowledge is as useful for fighting demons as it is for working with them.

addons.text: Soul Interventions: The worst skills a demonologist can possess as it allows the capture and trading of souls, which can convey great power at very little cost, at least to the demonologist themselves.
Summoning: Enhances the ability to conjure and bind malicious spirits into your cadre, as well as to barter for the summoning of powerful demonic items when you need them.

Summoning Magic: You have a talent for this; your cursed connection to the infernal realms is a blessing, allowing you to call forth demons more powerful than others can handle, and even understand their motivations, more easily manipulating them in your deals.

objects.title: Illusion Magic
objects.text: A school that specialises in the manipulation of light and the creation of unreal images. This is not merely for fooling and distracting: creating light and darkness has some very real tactical advantages, and to the master of illusion, creating falsehoods real enough to touch is possible.

addons.text: Artistry: Your skills as an artist are added to your skills as an illusionist, allowing for the creation of far more convincing or beautiful illusions.

Summoning Magic: You have a talent for this; bringing forth forgeries from your own mind without losing yourself to them will happen with an artistic inspiration. The heights of the ultimate illusion, fooling reality itself, will be within your grasp, as it reachable only for true natural talents.

objects.title: Sound Magic
objects.text: A companions school to illusion perhaps, creating sounds and voices from wherever the caster pleases, but it also includes devastating sound attacks that shatter bones, and the conveying of other spells through subtle sound, like mind control whispered through a song, or a summon conjured with a whistle.

addons.text: Summoning Magic: You have a talent for this; conjuring sound will be effortless, and the powers of the silent sounds -the inaudible spectrums- can lead to some frightening abilities that are difficult for most observers to comprehend.

objects.title: Dimensional Magic
objects.text: The knowledge to manipulate space, opening gates to other places you have been before, and bending reality to make looping infinite spaces, or places bigger inside than out. Very advanced users who study this art for centuries, can coax some minor chronomancy into their manipulations.

addons.text: Teleportation: Your natural ability is understood and boosted by a magical knowledge. You’ll be able to use transportation magic with considerable natural talent, even in combat, making it as easy as walking for you.

Folded Space: The pocket within yourself is understood and boosted by a magical knowledge. You’ll be able to expand the space you carry, and have better control over dimensional spaces created by magic.

Esoteric Magic: You have a talent for this; even the most mind bending of reality distortions can be understood with time, and recreated. The temporal element of it, should you choose to focus, can be expanded as well, allowing you to make minor alterations to nearby time without accidently erasing yourself.

objects.title: Talisman Magic
objects.text: A school that blends magic and crafting, allowing the binding of spells and spirits to objects or scrolls. This allows casting multiple pre-prepared powerful spells quickly, or carrying buffs that linger for longer. They don’t last forever, crumbling to dust after a few uses, but they’ve saved many lives and are valued by adventurers.

addons.text: Talisman makers are very versatile as they can work with any spell, either with enough time or with a pre-prepared guide made by someone else. Practitioners usually have knowledge of another school though, specialising in certain types of talismans. They’re fairly cheap to make, requiring only basic ingredients, though their quality does affect how long the item lasts.
Crafting: Your crafting skills lend very well to the talismans you make, allowing them to be far hardier. Wands, statues, jewellery, and trinkets of all kinds can carry your spells.

Esoteric Magic: You have a talent for this; making talismans will be a quicker thing, and the level and complexity of the magic to be scribed can be much higher than your standard trinket maker. Single use magical bombs can be produced on mass, and used to great effect.

objects.title: Enchanting
objects.text: The practice of writing magic into an item. Unlike talismans, these take more time to make, more materials, more power, and the effects are more passive to the item rather than triggered spells. The up side is that they don’t break or degrade after use and they sell for a higher amount.

addons.text: Enchanters often possess crafting skills: items made with enchanting in mind from the beginning are more powerful. Like with talismans, you don’t necessarily need skills in other magic forms, but it does help.
Smithing: Your skills with a forge allow you to make weapons and armour designed to hold enchantments from the beginning, allowing your enchanted items to be of a far higher quality.
Summoning: This allows for the creation of golems of all forms and functions. A renowned combination of schools as it’s the source of all modern constructs.

Talisman Magic: Skills in both enchanting and talismans work well together, allowing the creation of items with stable charges, that cast active spells and don’t break, but are drained and recover over time. Great for staff makers.

Esoteric Magic: You have a talent for this; your natural understanding allows for linked enchantments that can grow stronger with proximity to each other, along with just a better quality gained through simplified complexity.

objects.title: Glyph Magic
objects.text: A school of pre-prepared magic that allows for the writing of various runes and channelling patterns to produce an outcome. While this can be used for traps or quick fire bodily markings, it’s best used for rituals and spells too complex to speak or think in full for their casting time.

addons.text: Glyphs are used far and wide, for all complex spells and for magic beyond the normal abilities of its caster. Unlike Talisman Magic, this really does require knowledge of another school to get the full effect. Make sure you double check what you write as rituals going wrong rarely have pleasant results.

Esoteric Magic: You have a talent for this; the painstaking art of interconnecting magical matrices will be simple to your mathematical mind. There will be a much smaller chance of you getting it wrong, and the results you can achieve will be beyond the imaginations of lesser casters.

objects.title: Sexualised Magic’s
objects.text: An art that exists and touches upon all other magical schools; this is the study and understanding of pleasure through magic, how to enhance and stimulate sensation on a physical, mental, or even spiritual level. People are as delicate as they are perverted, and mages are a practical bunch; it’s better to study such things before jumping in.

addons.text: While coming equipped with its own unique spells, it’ll also allow the use of other schools magic in a safer and more pleasurable manner. Summoning, Dimensional, mind control etc. can all be repurposed to some delightful ends.

Esoteric Magic: You have a talent for this; bringing pleasure to others and yourself through magic will be a natural talent, along with stoking the sexual desires around you. You can even weave such proclivities into your usual spells, giving distracting advantages to hostile engagements.

objects.title: Magic Mixing
objects.text: Usually, the schools of magic stand apart; it is possible to bridge them and merge their effects, but it is also very hard, requiring learning both schools, and then studying the complex space between them. Due to the wide variety of possible variations, you may never find the teacher you’re looking for, yet with this, the interplay between all your magic knowledge is understood.

addons.text: It is worth noting that schools you have a talent for will allow you to work out merging them on your own, given time. Schools of the same type will also be easier to mix, ill matched ones will be harder, and some schools are already laid across the top of all others, like sexualised magic’s, enchanting, or glyphs. Does nothing without the knowledge of two or more schools.

objects.title: Grand Magic
objects.text: The heights of magic, whose effects can be felt across continents. These have insanely high costs, both in time and material, and garner attention from all over, both mundane and from celestial and infernal realms. These can be apocalyptic, especially if they go wrong, so they’re usually stopped.

addons.text: The last one of these brought demons into Eardheart, and another will be needed to get them out. No one is trusted enough to be allowed to attempt it, and should anyone try, everyone will attempt to stop them due to the risks of it going wrong. Some Key quests will be to stop magic like this. If you can pull it off though, in secret or in public, then you can gain power enough to make getting all the keys trivial. Requires other magic skills relevant to the great spells you want to cast.

objects.title: Counter-Counter Magic
objects.text: This covers more than counter spells; there are several interferences that can effect magic and its control. Oversaturation, magical dead zones, curses, nullified area’s, even people with auras of magically immunity. All are rare, but devastating for a mage. This is a challenging school that allows the stabilising of magic around you.

addons.text: Stabilised magic is still not ideal, but it allows for the casting of basic and intermediate spells when you otherwise couldn’t, without interruption from counters. Requires more concentration to work through. Learning it will be surprisingly hard; honest mages rarely need it, and witch hunters hide the knowledge from the less honest ones.

objects.title: Close Magic Skills
objects.text: Return to the choice of skills and knowledge.

objects.title: Close Skills and Knowledge
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: Future Experiences
rows.titleText:
While the future is unknown to you now, here, where it hasn’t happened yet, there are some things you can effect. Like laying something in your own future path, you can write some events that will come to pass with the turning of your stories pages.

That is not to say these events will not come to pass if you don’t pick them, but such would be leaving to chance what you can here mark as a certainty.

objects.title: A Mentor
objects.text: You will encounter a mentor figure, who will recognise your potential and help some of the talents you have flourish into real skills. While you will meet them, and they will teach you, any positive attitudes towards you are not guaranteed. They will have their own agendas, desires, and reasons for helping you.

objects.title: A Friend
objects.text: You will encounter someone who will become a stalwart friend, with skill enough to accompany you on your journey and survive. They will stick with you regardless of your chosen eccentricities, being adapted to them for better or worse. Loyal friends are not infinite though; you will encounter them, but they’ll leave if you don’t respect them.

objects.title: A Lover
objects.text: You will encounter someone who will become a sexual lover. Such things are wild and unpredictable; while they’ll be your preference, the form could be a whirlwind of passion or an enduring smoulder of the heart; an obsession perhaps, or a manipulation, or something more abusive, lasting longer than a night.

objects.title: Love
objects.text: The lover you take will truly feel love for you, and you will also feel for them in turn. It will be a strong enough bond to endure time and to cut deeply should loss befall you, but it will be of such quality that many will envy what you have. Selecting this ensures a wholesome romance with your lover.

objects.title: Combination
objects.text: You can combine your experiences into a single person, putting all of your eggs into one basket, so to speak. A mentor who becomes a friend who becomes a lover perhaps. It could smoulder as a ‘will they, won’t they’ situation, or erupt into an instant entanglement. The form is yours to choose.

addons.text: Only one selected: Requires at least two of the mentors, friends, and lovers to have any effect.
Only one selected: Requires at least two of the mentors, friends, and lovers to have any effect.
Only one selected: Requires at least two of the mentors, friends, and lovers to have any effect.
A Mentor & a Friend: A bond that grows with respect as an old master becomes an enduring comrade.

A Mentor & a Lover: A master and apprentice relationship that blossoms into teaching of sex and sexuality, or perhaps being their lover is a pre-requisite for their guarded knowledge? Perhaps it’s even an opportunity for you to teach them something.

A Friend & a Lover: Friends with benefits; the kind of relationship that can endure and grow stronger, or shatter never to be repaired. Or perhaps you’ll be lovers first, with true respect growing over time?

A Mentor, a Friend, a Lover: As described, a respectable mentor with benefits. For a time, and perhaps all time, they will be a very important person to you, with a strong and passionate bond binding you together.
True Love: Whatever combination you have, your love will be true, either growing over time, or their from the very start.

objects.title: A Party
objects.text: Finding people to join your adventure will not be challenging; many people seek the powers. Finding people who are capable, loyal, and whose abilities compliment and balance with your own, will be much harder. With this, you’ll encounter such people as you journey, building up a capable team.

addons.text: Many will tag along for their own reasons and be loyal to the end. Some seek the powers themselves and may need to be dissuaded for them to stay loyal throughout. It will be active so long as you feel you need more people, giving up to 5 per year, and no more than 10 overall. They’ll also leave if you abuse them, but will put the effort in if you otherwise struggle to communicate.

objects.title: A Remarkable Feat
objects.text: Fate will converge to place you in a situation that you, and perhaps only you, can solve. This will cement a reputation far and wide, generally positive, that will overshadow a lot of the negative points about you. This is the kind of event that spawns heroic nicknames.

objects.title: A Breath-taking Experience
objects.text: Beauty is not guaranteed in any world, but the chance to see something, be it a place, a person, or an event, that truly awes you to your core -that changes you, making memories that you will carry with you and smile to think upon- is something only a fool would give up on.

objects.title: A Chance for Power
objects.text: The trickiest to lay before you, but perhaps events could conspire to leave an opportunity available. An advantageous demon deal, or a godly quest with high reward, or an item unearthed with unexpected abilities. It doesn’t guarantee you’ll recognise and capitalise on the event, only that the reward will be worth it if you do.

objects.title: Plot Armour
objects.text: Wherever your journey goes, you will not die for the selected number of years. This is not fool proof, and should you do something truly stupid, you will die. You can also find yourself in some very grim situations, but with this, life will find a way.

addons.text: Reincarnation: This will begin after your normal plot armour wears off.

objects.title: Close Experiences
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: You have gained all you came to claim…
rows.titleText:
Your form shines brighter, your future clearer, as this lucid dream takes a beautiful form, lighter than air or the very stars.

Save for weighing you down enough to walk once more as a person, what more is there to dream on? Need you make it even a moment bitterer than it needs to be? Perhaps from here it could be over? After all…

objects.title: You’ve Taken What You Need
objects.text: Select this to unlock the final option of The World In Sight, your new world alive with anticipation.

objects.title: Close Boons
objects.text: Return to the world in sight.

rows.title: The Burdens of a Balanced Being
rows.titleText:
Balance is a tightrope, as wide as a road or as thin as a razor wire. It is your choice as to which, and for all the sweetness’s you’ve lain upon your journey, an equal amount of bitterness must be in order, lest you cleave yourself in two with your first step. You must turn upon yourself the tortures an ill mind would wish upon an enemy, yet you needn’t be a tyrant. Balanced. All things must be balanced.

Still, some small part of you looks upon the task with self-sadistic glee, eager to give of yourself to gain, slave to the balance that must be maintained. You’ll need to walk your way anyway; surely a wider path would have its own charms.

objects.title: Decreasing Stats
objects.text: The most basic and most influential of changes.

objects.title: Curses
objects.text: A variety of changes, each a malfeasance to carry.

objects.title: Vulnerabilities
objects.text: Weaknesses and sacrifices, your defences lowered.

objects.title: Deepened Dream
objects.text: Blurred lines of reality and nightmare.

objects.title: Mentalities
objects.text: Your psychological compass redirected, unnoticed.

objects.title: Experiences
objects.text: Events not yet happened, placed upon your path.

rows.title: Decreasing Your Stats
rows.titleText:
You look at all that was considered when adding to yourself, now to the purpose of subtracting, your baseline abilities decreasing as you cut the abilities of your currently mighty self. Here, you must be careful; reducing yourself too much could leave you an empty husk, unable to achieve your dream or live even a normal life. 

If reducing yourself considerably, you’ll need to think of a way to keep going without. Perhaps a divine caster, weak as normal, but bolstered with blessed magic when threatened, or a warrior with paper thin skin, blessed elsewhere with the power to regenerate, or perhaps even an uncharismatic monster, whose raw strength can carry you through.

You needn’t reduce anything though, and of course it would be best if you didn’t, but life can be a horribly unbalanced thing.

objects.title: Reduced Strength
objects.text: The physical strength of the body. If endurance is what your body can take of the world, strength is how much you can physically effect the world around you. A world of armoured men and armoured beasts, and where might so often makes right. This is vital for any physical combatant to achieve victory.

addons.text: Strength 1 or less - Your very body is too heavy to lift, your arms and legs too weak to rise and effect the world. You have all the strength of someone dying from a wasting illness, limiting your ability to do even the most basic tasks of looking after yourself.

Strength 2 - Your physical strength is no longer an adorable nuisance, now being very low, inhibiting your ability to do basic tasks, like opening doors or picking up objects. You will be completely at the mercy of anyone who gets close to you.

Strength 3 - You are weak. Fighting physically against all but the most wispy of opponents will be laughable, along with opening heavy doors or doing manual labour. You will crumple under many of the burdens others carry.
Strength 4 - You’re below the average that could be expected of you, needing help to lift heavy things, and generally being a bit of a weakling.
Strength 5 - The average strength for your race, build, and gender. Unremarkable to most in the same weight class.
Strength 6 - You have an above average physical strength, same as that possessed by someone who works a physical job day to day, only yours is a natural baseline.
Strength 7 - You have high strength, same as that of a warrior, whose life relies on being stronger than their opponent.

Strength 8 - A powerfully high strength, same as someone who trains regularly or takes few breaks from some very demanding labour. Opponents that train to wear heavy armour and weald large blunt weapons must reach this kind of strength.

Strength 9 - The few mortals who would reach this strength would be those who obsess with it and dedicate much of their time to its development, even at the expense of other things, like skills or tactics. Strongmen who can lift others over their heads, or throw great weights long distances in competition with each other.

Strength 10 - The strongest a mortal can reach through work, and a new record for your kind. This is the strength that crushes others, giving bare hands an easy killing force. Lifting the weight of a fully laden horse will surely bring about gasps of amazement from watchers, just as cleaving through steel will bring cries of despair from your foes.

Strength 11 to 13 - Beyond mortal strength: the ability to tear a man limb from limb with your bear hands. Your fists become sledgehammers and your weapons strike like booming thunder, and the thickest armour feels as light as winter clothes.

Strength 14 to 16 - You can shatter stone and rend steel with a fist, throwing whole groups of men terminal distances. Yours is a strength used to wrestle great beasts, leap cities, and hurl great boulders; it will bring fame and fear, even unto demons and the beings of the outer realms.

Strength 17 to 19 - Your steps can shatter the ground and cross continents in leaps. A sweep of your hand could cut a man in half, and no weight, not even a mountain, could keep you pinned. It is a strength that divine beings fear, able to shatter even immaterial forms, your stronger blows distorting reality itself.

Strength >20 - The strength of a god. Technically, you can never land a strike against another at full strength, for the shockwave of one punch would burn air and flesh and break apart matter before it can even travel through it. Such strength should not exist within anything as delicate as reality.

Endurance 6 or less: Powerful strength may still damage a weak body, as a strong punch will not break your arm, but the steel you shatter with it may. Only strong weapons can carry your strength safely, and unless they are reinforced, perhaps only once.

Endurance 8 or less: Powerful strength may still damage a weak body, as a strong punch will not break your arm, but the steel you shatter with it may. Only strong weapons can carry your strength safely, and unless they are reinforced, perhaps only once.

Endurance 10 or less: Powerful strength may still damage a weak body, as a strong punch will not break your arm, but the steel you shatter with it may. Only strong weapons can carry your strength safely, and unless they are reinforced, perhaps only once.

objects.title: Reduced Dexterity
objects.text: The ability to move with precision and speed; a vital trait for any ranger, bowman, or lightly armoured combatant. Also governs your flexibility and general kinaesthetic intellect, required for acrobatics, dancing, stealth, and deft action of any kind. It doesn’t give you skills like lock picking, but you’ll be able to learn them much more easily.

addons.text: Dexterity 1 or less - Your dexterity is as nil as a quadruple amputee. Perhaps that is the case, or perhaps your body is so unresponsive that you need others to feed you. Walking won’t be happening, but you could still live wheeled around by carers, who would need to do even the simplest tasks for you.
Dexterity 2 - Your lack of bodily mobility has a noticeable impact upon your life, slowing even the most simple of tasks that now require multiple attempts to perform.
Dexterity 3 - You’re undexterous, with hands that shake where precision is needed and two left feet that see each other as bitter enemies. Your body is saddled with stiff and awkward movement.
Dexterity 4 - Below average dexterity. Expect to be considered somewhat clumsy, being more inclined to fall or drop things.
Dexterity 5 - An average dexterity that lets you walk normally, without falling on your face.
Dexterity 6 - Above average dexterity. You’ll rarely trip and have a natural quickness and grace to your movements.
Dexterity 7 - You’re a very dextrous person, able to move quickly and accurately. This is a level reached by professional assassins, pickpockets, and anyone who works hard to have their work unseen.
Dexterity 8 - Yours is the level of great acrobats and contortionists, street runners and famous archers. Your hands move so quickly, it can be hard for the average eye to follow them.

Dexterity 9 - Your moves are incredibly fluid, lending themselves to close combat very well. In terms of finesse, there are few who could match you, let alone beat you, and if they try you can slip, run, or sneak away without fear of being caught.

Dexterity 10 - Yours is truly a cat like agility. Natural: a grace and fluidity that cannot be trained, only born with. Double if not triple jointed, able to escape near any bonds, fast and skilled. A blur, a shadow, and a beauty in your movements.

Dexterity 11 to 13 - Beyond mortal limits, you have a grace that you can use from which even eyes cannot hold onto, the sights of people slipping away, their minds rejecting the style and poise of which you’re capable. Your natural skills leave you able to strike any object with any weapon, and able to dodge any targeted strikes in turn.

Dexterity 14 to 16 - Should you pick something up, your body will work out how to use it before your brain does. The unnatural understanding of your physical abilities leaves anything a weapon, becoming an extension of your will the moment you touch it. You can dodge the undogable, like wide spells and far reaching curses.

Dexterity 17 to 19 - You’re able to move so smoothly that some would doubt you moved at all, slipping through light and shadow with such ability that you can travel further than you move, leaving you a dizzyingly untrackable opponent.

Dexterity >20 - You can move with such grace that mortal (and many immortal) eyes simply cannot see you, even standing before them. Your speed is without equal, not just in the blur of your hands, but in the way you travel, an acrobatic through space and time.

Perception 6 or less: The art of reacting and striking and slipping through necessitates a good perception of the world. Without this, your perfect movements are more likely to hit a brick wall, figuratively and literally, and while you can react quickly to it, you’re more often leaping before you look.

Perception 8 or less: The art of reacting and striking and slipping through necessitates a good perception of the world. Without this, your perfect movements are more likely to hit a brick wall, figuratively and literally, and while you can react quickly to it, you’re more often leaping before you look.

Perception 10 or less: The art of reacting and striking and slipping through necessitates a good perception of the world. Without this, your perfect movements are more likely to hit a brick wall, figuratively and literally, and while you can react quickly to it, you’re more often leaping before you look.

objects.title: Reduced Endurance
objects.text: The robustness of the body and its ability to endure all thrown against it. This covers not just physical blows, but the ravishes of disease, age, and spirit. It carries reserves of energy against fatigue, and governs the recovery over time. A defensive skill, working only on yourself, at least outside of races and drinking competitions.

addons.text: Endurance 1 or less - Your own body barely has the strength to go on. A slight breeze could be the end of you, and all your vital organs seem on the brink of rebellion in the face of their terrible working conditions. You’d need a skilled healer just to keep you from dropping dead.

Endurance 2 - You’ll need a healer on standby to keep going, patching you up every time your paper skin gets cut, or you glass bones break, or a sickness most would shrug off lays you out. This is the life of the fragile invalid who can scarcely leave their bed.

Endurance 3 - Your bodies health is not great, leaving you fatigued long before the day is done, and wheezing after only moderate exercise. Illness is not uncommon, though semi-regular ministrations from a healer should keep you going.
Endurance 4 - Your endurance is below average, leaving you out of breath more quickly, and more susceptible to catching minor illnesses, like common colds.
Endurance 5 - An average amount of endurance. You can run, jump, and swim as well as anyone who does not do those things often.
Endurance 6 - Your endurance is above average, letting you run further, last longer, and shrug off minor sicknesses faster, should you even catch them at all.
Endurance 7 - You have a robust immune system, seeming to never get sick, and you can stay in combat as long as a full trained and seasoned warrior. A picture of health and fitness.

Endurance 8 - Your body is more than fit; it is hardy. Your bones are stronger, your muscles denser. A fall that may shatter another would leave you only bruised and bloody, and you could fight for hours, even while carrying a great weight of armour or a significant wound. Cuts heal quickly, and rarely leave a scar.

Endurance 9 - A blow that would lay another out may scarcely stagger you, and a feat that would leave another paralysed with exhaustion may hardly raise your breath. Few ever train their bodies to this extent as few need to, nor have the hours to sink into such a pursuit. For you it is a baseline.

Endurance 10 - The pinnacle of mortal endurance. When people tell tales of those who survive impossible odds, pushing themselves beyond, if only for a moment, it is this peak they reach, coming down through only death or salvation. It is here you live, able to endure more than the worst any could be expected to.

Endurance 11 to 13 - An endurance beyond mortal limits. Blades do not cut deeply; great wounds for another would be flesh wounds to you, and glancing blows leave barely a mark. You require less sleep, and always have some reserve of energy, no matter how tired you get. You’re not outright immune to disease, but can develop an immunity soon after catching, no matter what it is.

Endurance 14 to 16 - You can watch your wounds knit themselves closed, such is your healing, and you never run out of blood. You could be cut in half and so long as your brain is intact, you could grow yourself back in time. You do not get tired, or exhausted, and sleep is optional for you. Your body even shrugs off magical curses.

Endurance 17 to 19 - You do not age past your prime, and it takes only seconds to regrow whole limbs, leaving you frightfully difficult to kill. Food and water become semi-optional, needing very little to keep going at your very best, and even the worst diseases and poisons have no effect on you at all.

Endurance >20 - Immortality, of body at least. You could be reduced to dust and still return, yet there is very little that could render you so. Your skin is impenetrable, your bones unbreakable. Beware though, as your mind and will may not be so robust, and without strength against all imprisonment, this immortal life may become a terrible curse.

Will 6 or less: While you can take the hits, you still feel the pain. A lack of will may leave you unable to stand or emotionally bear an attack that you can take physically, leaving long term trauma and scars on the mind.

Will 8 or less: While you can take the hits, you still feel the pain. A lack of will may leave you unable to stand or emotionally bear an attack that you can take physically, leaving long term trauma and scars on the mind.

Will 10 or less: While you can take the hits, you still feel the pain. A lack of will may leave you unable to stand or emotionally bear an attack that you can take physically, leaving long term trauma and scars on the mind.

objects.title: Reduced Perception
objects.text: More than mere sight and sound, perception is the interpretation of sensory information. It not only sharpens the senses, but lets you know how people feel and what’s coming next. It requires intelligence and wisdom to know why, but without either, you’ll be able to predict things and react to them without knowing the exact reason.

addons.text: Perception 1 or less - Functionally blind, deaf, and numb to the world, you’ll be at the mercy of everyone and everything around you, unable to predict anything that may come next.

Perception 2 - Your senses are generally dulled, or some are missing altogether. Anything unplanned will catch you unguarded, and both puzzles and mysteries will always be lacking some pieces, left unseen or unconnected in your periphery.

Perception 3 - With very little perception, from your perspective, most things just happen. Perhaps you can work out the cause afterward, but not in the moment, where ambush, unusual behaviour, and strange decision will come and go without you picking up any nuance.
Perception 4 - You have below average perception, leaving you surprised more often than most and able to miss details more easily.
Perception 5 - An average sense of perception. You notice things with your senses as well as anyone.
Perception 6 - You have above average perception. People will compliment you when you see or pickup on things that they missed.

Perception 7 - You’re very perceptive, carrying the skills of a detective or ranger. Tracking people and animals comes more easily, as well as picking up on small social cues most miss. Seeing lies or feints in attacks comes more easily as well.

Perception 8 - The studying of body language leave people as open books, their stoic thoughts and feeling as apparent as if they were laughing or crying. Your accuracy with ranged weapons is significantly improved as well.

Perception 9 - Adductive or deductive, your reasoning gets a tremendous boost, leaving you able to look about a scene and work out what happened, with each minor detail telling a story. In combat or game, you’re near untrickable, and it would take a master of stealth to hide from your sight.

Perception 10 - Your perceptions are at the limit of what can be considered perceptions, and while some may be able to reach such a height, most will think your abilities supernatural. From a glance at the clouds, you can tell the weather for the week, from the smell of food, you can tell who baked it, and from the sound of a step, you can tell if someone is left or right handed.

Perception 11 to 13 - Your senses become super-natural, enabling you to sense any attack before it happens. You can tell when something is about to go down before anyone, even the instigators know, and in combat, all the weaknesses of a typical opponent is revealed to you, from supernatural weaknesses to old wounds and trick knees.

Perception 14 to 16 - Your senses reach through reality, picking up on the spiritual realms and creeping outer forces. Concentrations of magical power are laid bare, and things hidden by walls or magical means are as clear to you as if they were laid out at your feet.

Perception 17 to 19 - Your perceptions reach through time, letting you see the past through its remnants, the histories of everything laid out to your mind, traceable from the present to its creation. Even the future can be compiled, echoing faintly back with confusing mirrored lines of distorted possibilities. With a strong enough mind or will, you could use this to shape events.

Perception >20 - Your senses are, without doubt, divine in their abilities. You can see beyond the horizon, hear words forming in peoples minds, smell the flowers that are yet seeds, and taste events a thousand years past. The meddling of the gods is clear to you, both in their schemes and in the creation of the world, their fingerprints as clear as oily residue. All of it flows easily, and can be ignored, but others may seek to use, or silence, such powerful abilities.

Intelligence 6 or less: Knowing what to look for and what to filter out, along with processing all the information your get, requires a mind that can keep up. Without this, you can still perceive the same, and react to it, but your mind may crack if you try to understand it.

Intelligence 8 or less: Knowing what to look for and what to filter out, along with processing all the information your get, requires a mind that can keep up. Without this, you can still perceive the same, and react to it, but your mind may crack if you try to understand it.

Intelligence 10 or less: Knowing what to look for and what to filter out, along with processing all the information your get, requires a mind that can keep up. Without this, you can still perceive the same, and react to it, but your mind may crack if you try to understand it.

objects.title: Reduced Charisma
objects.text: Physical beauty can leave others desiring you, and strength of will or arms can make them listen, but Charisma can make them respect you, and follow you, fighting and dying for your cause. The first rulers of Dormientes claimed their keys and their sliver of the power by leading armies on their quests. Perhaps you could do the same.

addons.text: Charisma 1 or less - You cannot communicate even basic ideas with others, your every word and gesture, or even your very existence being seen as an insult, and the result will be an outward hostility from everyone around you, turning you into a pariah, no matter what you do.

Charisma 2 - Making friends will be very difficult, if not impossible. You manner will be unfixably ‘off’ or even unnerving, and people will not trust you for it, even doing the opposite of what you ask in fear of your ulterior motives.

Charisma 3 - The charisma of a wall flower. Prepare to be ignored or dismissed if you try to initiate a conversation, requiring hostility and insult to be heard, your stammering presence treated as an irritation. You can still earn respect through action, making friendships and ‘being the quiet one’ or ‘good in small doses’, but keeping it monosyllabic should keep people from your throat or treating you as disposable.
Charisma 4 - Below average charisma, you’ll struggle to convince anyone of your point of view, but can do so with time and effort.
Charisma 5 - An average charisma, able to interact with others and negotiate for what you want within reason.
Charisma 6 - Above average charisma, allowing you to smoothly interact with others and be a much more personable person.

Charisma 7 - Buying and selling goods will become much easier and more profitable for you as you take on a salesman’s charm, and the traits of a leader will have others looking to you for direction. Your skills at song, story, and dance will be much easier to cultivate, should you choose.

Charisma 8 - Talking others into doing things for you, be it fighting for you or joining you in bed, will be quite easy. You have the effortless oratory of a captivating public speaker, and the unshakable outward confidence of someone utterly correct.

Charisma 9 - The rare charm that leads to celebrity status; others are drawn to your magnetism. Expect to be invited to a lot of parties, with the wealthy elite paying you for your presence. You have the stance of a hero, and the gravitas of a king.

Charisma 10 - Your presence is a sun that all bask in, your words, your stance, your smile, all the thing of champions, yet all within the realms of possibility. Just from talking to people, they will assume your greatness, and it will take very little to form armies and have songs sung about you.

Charisma 11 to 13 - Entering into the magic charms of faye creatures, your words more irresistible, your suggestions seen as automatically correct, even if absurd. This is not mind control, but something far more dangerous, and far harder to guard against. Persuasion.

Charisma 14 to 16 - When you speak, others listen, be they friend or foe. Your words cut to their hearts, breaking their will or fortifying their resolve, and even heavenly or infernal beings may smile and stop and listen, caught in your presence like a ship in a whirlpool.

Charisma 17 to 19 - Enemies, be they man or beast, may throw down their weapons and kneel before you, such is the authority you emanate. Your words are right, following them is good, and even divinity may be captivated by the radiance of your personality.

Charisma >20 - You are the epitome of persuasion. Your stories could convince gods to cry and demons to repent. Your suggestions could make birds dig and fish fly. Even stone faced reality may bend to accommodate you, made unsure of itself by the glow of your smile, or desperate to correct the crease of your frown.

Will 6 or less: Without a strong conviction, words are just words. As compelling as they are, lacking the ability to stand in the face of resolute opposition will make convincing people to change their minds much harder.

Will 8 or less: Without a strong conviction, words are just words. As compelling as they are, lacking the ability to stand in the face of resolute opposition will make convincing people to change their minds much harder.

Will 10 or less: Without a strong conviction, words are just words. As compelling as they are, lacking the ability to stand in the face of resolute opposition will make convincing people to change their minds much harder.

objects.title: Reduced Intelligence
objects.text: Your mind is perhaps your strongest weapon, yet be careful. Without the hands to wield it, be they the convictions of those who follow you or your own strength elsewhere, it is no more than a thought in a jar; a sharp sword collecting dust. There is nothing worse than knowing the answer and being powerless to enact it.

addons.text: Intelligence 1 or less - You have no mind and suffer the blissful ignorance of the drooling vegetable.
Intelligence 2 - You are, at best, clinically retarded, with a mind that goes no further in complex thought than that of a young child.

Intelligence 3 - You are what epitomises a stupid person, using crude, brutish, and ineffectual solutions to your problems. Perhaps you can power through, but it’ll be harder going than it should be, and you won’t know why.
Intelligence 4 - The slower side of average. A depressing number of people are here so at least you will not be alone.
Intelligence 5 - The mind of an average person, no faster, no slower. Your thoughts flow with a typical agility.
Intelligence 6 - The quicker side of average. More flexible in thought than most, but still ‘normal’ in mind. People may comment upon the reliability of your memory, or the danger of your quick wit.
Intelligence 7 - You are a typical smart person, taking to complex subjects like engineering and strategy, and recalling things not actively committed to memory with ease.

Intelligence 8 - You are considered very intelligent. Subjects like genetics, advanced magical theorem, and grand strategy, come easily to you, as long as they capture your interest. Very often, you’ll reliably be the smartest person in the room.

Intelligence 9 - You are in the highest percentiles of intelligence, where great inventors, composers, theorists, and wizards lie. Such people are dotted throughout history, their impressive passing usually noted.

Intelligence 10 - Your mind is at the maximum limit of human intellect: the new smartest. Like any record, one would hope it will be beaten soon enough, and perhaps it will, but for now, you can guarantee being the smarted mortal in the world not backed by external forces. Your memory will be flawless and your speed of thought unmatched by any peers.

Intelligence 11 to 13 - Were you a character in a book, your intellect rises to the point of being unrealistic, with many Machiavellian schemes coming quickly and easily. This means you have surpassed mortal limits, and plenty of immortals as well, but to some of the true intellects out there, you’re still just a child.

Intelligence 14 to 16 - Your mind is considered powerful, even among powerful minds. Creatures drawn to intelligence, who live in the high arenas of mind, be they divine gods, scheming demons, or hungering mind flayers, will come to you to sample your intellect, though conversation or less savoury means, and use it for their own ends if they can.

Intelligence 17 to 19 - You reach the kind of intellectual heights where games against gods of mind can be played, should you get their attention. You may not win, but you can give them a run for their money. As for the mortal word, stupid and violent as it is, you’ll be as safe as a genius among monsters; your mind will be beyond mortal comprehension, and the problems of people will seem trivial to solve.

Intelligence >20 - There are horrifying creatures of the deepest deep, whose simplest thoughts are like planets teeming with life and whose memories stretch beyond the earliest dawn of time. To them, who are able to look into the beating heart of the universe and make it flinch, your mind is an unknowable terrifying horror, utterly beyond their comprehension.

Wisdom 6 or less: Without the understanding of other people’s point of view, you’ll be unable to relate to others properly, struggling to understand their more limited perspective. You’re also more likely to be less grounded, getting lost in thought more easily.

Wisdom 8 or less: Without the understanding of other people’s point of view, you’ll be unable to relate to others properly, struggling to understand their more limited perspective. You’re also more likely to be less grounded, getting lost in thought more easily.

Wisdom 10 or less: Without the understanding of other people’s point of view, you’ll be unable to relate to others properly, struggling to understand their more limited perspective. You’re also more likely to be less grounded, getting lost in thought more easily.

objects.title: Reduced Wisdom
objects.text: If intelligence is the tool, wisdom is the hand that wealds it. Wisdom helps you empathise with others, keeping you ‘normal’ and able to relate to them, despite your fame, intellect, will, or perceptions. It helps you understand yourself and thus get the best of yourself. It helps you speak in a relatable manner when leading or negotiating with others, and generally helps any pursuit.

addons.text: Wisdom 1 or less - The world is incomprehensible to you, it’s people like aliens, its laws and rules senseless mazes where logic doesn’t even begin to apply. There are undead with more empathy, blind people with more foresight, and dying people with less fear.

Wisdom 2 - You’re in your own little world most of the time, distracted by things that matter very little, to the point of being blind to much around you. Problems are rarely solved, plans are never made, and you may need someone to make sure you remember to eat from time to time.

Wisdom 3 - A complete scatter brain, always late, always distracted, and unable to conceive of why that would upset other people unless they explain it to you. Understanding the basics of Ki is impossible.

Wisdom 4 - Less wise, less understanding. You may struggle to relate with others, taking longer paths and more complicated solutions due to missing obvious alternatives. Mastering any kind of Ki would be very difficult.
Wisdom 5 - A typical amount of wisdom. You know what you like and don’t like, and from that, you can guess what others may like or not like.

Wisdom 6 - More wisdom than most, you can take on other peoples positions, including your future self, predicting and planning for what you want to happen. Sniffing out lies will be a little easier, and learning techniques of self-improvement will be easier as well.

Wisdom 7 - Your plans may remain the same, but your goals are improved, and your potential paths to achieve it are streamlined with a clarity of purpose and an understanding of the world around you. It will be very difficult to lie to you

Wisdom 8 - Understanding of the self and the world allows for influence over the self and the world. Monks who channel their focus and pursue enlightenment can push themselves in all areas, becoming stronger and faster than their bodies may otherwise allow.

Wisdom 9 - A sublime understanding of yourself and the world around you. There are monks sequestered on mountains, seeking enlightenment, who rarely reach this level of understanding and oneship with the world.

Wisdom 10 - The peak of mortal wisdom, that lets you understand the goals you have and the goals you should have. A perfected understanding of the self, the world, and the harmony of the two. Your soul is your own, leaving you immune to those who would manipulate it.

Wisdom 11 to 13 - The first step on the path of enlightenment and divinity. Understanding of the self unlocks new abilities and new paths, and many within the world (and some outside of it) will seek your opinion on how to improve themselves. You’ll be able to control your own internal bodily functions to some extent, redirecting energies into all of your endeavours.

Wisdom 14 to 16 - A smart person can engineer a way to divert whole rivers, yet it is said a wise person can divert it by placing a single stone in just the right place. Your wisdom and understanding allows for such feats of oneness with reality. Things like walking on water, stepping on air, or being immovable in the face of great force will all be possible.

Wisdom 17 to 19 - Reality and perception go hand in hand. Telling your body it is not sick or injured will be the first step in making it so, or redirecting energies from growing hair or nail into changing yourself, hardening skin and bone, or even seeking greater transformations and abilities.

Wisdom >20 - Stepping into the divine realms is simply a case of knowing where to place your feet. Your wisdom and intuitive knowledge leave everyone, including the gods, in awe and seeking your council as you reconceptualise problems with new perspectives, finding solutions that seem obvious with hindsight.
Charisma 6 or less: Unable to phrase your wisdom palatably, sharing it is more likely to anger others, resulting in few seeking out your advice, and fewer still acting upon it.
Charisma 8 or less: Unable to phrase your wisdom palatably, sharing it is more likely to anger others, resulting in few seeking out your advice, and fewer still acting upon it.
Charisma 10 or less: Unable to phrase your wisdom palatably, sharing it is more likely to anger others, resulting in few seeking out your advice, and fewer still acting upon it.

objects.title: Reduced Will
objects.text: The power of your character, your stubbornness, your defiance. Endurance doesn’t matter if you don’t have the heart to take a hit, and strength falls short without the courage to deliver the blow. This will also effects divine abilities, changing your strength of presence in the outer realms, where what is is decided by what you will it to be.

addons.text: Will 1 or less - You are a puppet without any will at all, hollow and controlled by whoever gives you orders. Your body is theirs, your mind is theirs: a toy or tool to be fought over and used.

Will 2 - Very little will of your own, resulting in you seeking out others to make decisions for you, even if they don’t have your best interests at heart. Choosing your own path will be very difficult.

Will 3 - You’re someone who cannot stand difficulty and hardships, always choosing the easier path in life. Making decisions or putting in the effort will be forever put on the back burner unless the situation absolutely requires it.

Will 4 - The below average will of someone who may be called a push over, yielding to the orders and suggestions of others with uncommon regularity. Particularly sensitive to mind control and quite conflict avoidant.
Will 5 - The average will of a person, swayed by the words of friend and foe alike, and adverse to hardship and pain.

Will 6 - Above average will. This could also be called ‘sales resistance’, leaving you a little more resolute in the face of opposition. This extends to mind control and other mental influence as well, giving some small measure of resistance to all persuasion.

Will 7 - The tempered will of a warrior or crusader, who can face hardships both physical and mental and come out the other side. Many combative religious orders train their people to this heightened level, giving them courage and conviction in the face of their enemies. Pain will be more bearable.

Will 8 - The level of religious leaders, and importantly clerics who channel advanced miracles of the outer realms. This will be needed to convince outer beings you don’t supplicate yourself to of your righteousness, or at least to stay somewhat out of your way. You can go on where most others would collapse from mental fatigue.

Will 9 - In a battle of wills, there are few who would not blink before you. That strength of personality and purpose can be instrumental in bringing people to your cause, or at least convincing them that you can actually pull off what you’re looking to achieve. Mind control will be near useless on you.

Will 10 - People of such strong will are impossibly rare, seen as a little bit mad, yet becoming beacons of focus in pursuit of their goal that can sweep other people along in their wake. Usually, it is only death that stops such people, and in a world of gods and undeath, sometimes not even that.

Will 11 to 13 - A will that can be considered inhuman. You could be a child saying you will fight god and win, and such will be the look in your eyes that some will catch themselves believing it. Beings from the outer realms, both ‘up’ and ‘down’, will pause to listen, and give your words credence.

Will 14 to 16 - Should you die with your work undone, you may return as an undead, if not already, crawling out of your grave to finish the job. Should you pray, you will be listened to, and you can brow-beat anyone, even some angels and demons, into doing what you tell them, simply for the asking. Pain will be outright ignorable.

Will 17 to 19 - Magic is technically a thing of will, whether its manipulation is from inside or outside of reality. With enough will, you have gained a form of magic resistance: the ability to tell the softer parts of reality to ‘not do that’ and be listened to. You gain an immunity of mind, with not even the most extreme situations breaking your sanity, and even regular reality will occasionally bend to your demands should it leave an obstacle in your way.

Will >20 - To stand in the divine realms is to be its new centre: a point so immovable that reality must move first. If you need a god to negotiate, they will. You may not get what you want, but the force of your personality is so great in the outer realms that they’ll give you something, even just to get you to leave them alone. Beware though, as nothing will stop your mission, even if you must be reduced to a raw vengeful ghost to complete it. You can become trapped between your will and your lacking abilities.

Wisdom 6 or less: Will accelerates you forward, but wisdom is the much needed breaks. Without it, you will be stubborn, pushing forwards and through obstacles that a wiser person would walk around, and ignoring advice that would help you toward your goals.

Wisdom 8 or less: Will accelerates you forward, but wisdom is the much needed breaks. Without it, you will be stubborn, pushing forwards and through obstacles that a wiser person would walk around, and ignoring advice that would help you toward your goals.

Wisdom 10 or less: Will accelerates you forward, but wisdom is the much needed breaks. Without it, you will be stubborn, pushing forwards and through obstacles that a wiser person would walk around, and ignoring advice that would help you toward your goals.

objects.title: Close Stat Subtractions
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: Cursed Reality
rows.titleText:
The curses you can place upon yourself here should help to provide some stability for your journey. Like ballast in a sky high balloon or in a deep sea vessel, you needn’t carry them with you for eternity; achieving the power that lies in the heart of Dormientes will allow you to shrug off these burdens if you so choose, or keep them as trophies and old scars, to inform your days ahead. The same goes for any such curses not intrinsic to your being.

Many of these will make your journey more dangerous and unpleasant, yet you needn’t take any. A more temperate journeyman, less inclined to extremes of purchase and power, may gleefully pass such offering by.

objects.title: Ugly Attraction
objects.text: You’ll find that those who join you or that you are most likely to interact with, will not be so easy on the eye. This does not drain the world of beautiful people, but does make sure those who show an interest in you, as lover, comrade, or bystander, are more likely to be physically average or below.

addons.text: Ugly or Below Average: Being ugly among the ugly can soften the blow, being less distinct by comparison.
Above Average or Beautiful: Surrounded by ugliness, expect your beauty to stand out far more.

objects.title: Lightweight
objects.text: Some can handle alcohol better than others, but you are not one of them. It takes very little to get you buzzed, and only a little more to see you sloshed, near passed out and vulnerable. If other people know this, they may use it against you. Beware, a lot of alchemical potions use alcohol as an ingredient.

addons.text: Ugly Attraction: One drink and you’re near guaranteed to wake up beside someone as ugly as your headache.

objects.title: Curse of Transformation
objects.text: Your body will transform in small ways periodically, leaving you as a chimera of different parts. While hideous, this can give some bestial advantages, and you’ll always be able to function mostly, with perhaps limps and slurred words being the worst of it. You’ll gain something new every month, and be near unrecognisable after a year.

addons.text: Any Body Transformation: While you can use magic or your natural gifts to turn yourself back or into something else, the curse is not gracious in its defeat. Any transformations not of the curse become Agonising Transformations to make, same as the same named curse, unless the changes are to conform to your current ‘true form’.

objects.title: Agonising Transformation
objects.text: Transforming your body in any way causes an extremely painful and grotesque intermediate process. Bones will crack as they lengthen, muscles tearing and healing in news shapes, your skin stretching to accommodate the new flesh beneath it. The time taken is the same, though understandably, it will feel much longer.

addons.text: Curse of Transformation: The curse is delighted with this effect, allowing it to slow down its changes to happening in bursts every couple of months, doing two months worth of changes in one brutal go.
Pain Control: This will be a pain you cannot nullify, and if you’re unused to pain, this may even hurt worse.

objects.title: Light Averse
objects.text: Not only do vampires shun the sun, but some subterranean creatures as well. Some Drow and Dwarves report an intense dislike and aversion to sunlight, and this is what you will have, driving you underground or operating only at night. This can lead to ill health if not of a race that supports such a lifestyle.

addons.text: This is only a strong dislike and comes with no physical pain or damage as a vampire might. It can even be overcome, in the same way an aversion to eating shit can be overcome, which is to say, you won’t want to overcome it.

objects.title: Betrayal Magnet
objects.text: People will be inclined to betray you, with only the friends and allies chosen in the dream being immune from this. Others will sell you out, use you, mislead you for their own profit. It will not be everyone, but many will see you as ‘fair game’ to their own schemes, uncaring if you’re hurt along the way.

objects.title: Trouble Lure
objects.text: The bane and makings of a hero’s tale. Brigands, goblins, demons, cults, and all the stray predators of the world may find themselves in your path, your road always leading to trouble as ‘adventure’ manages to find you. These deadly distractions may increase your renown, but peace and rest will be harder to come by.

objects.title: Unwholesome Situations
objects.text: You will find yourself more often in predicaments of an unsavoury nature. While the situations won’t target you specifically, you may find yourself stumbling into murders, cult sacrifices, demon summoning’s, and clandestine plots, as well as teaming up with those with hidden allegiances or ulterior motives.

addons.text: This does not make the world darker, but does make sure its darker elements can be found in your path, and makes your story a much darker tale.

Trouble Lure: A troll taking umbrage with you and chasing you down is different to a child being beaten to death by a drunk father. In many ways, it’s more dangerous, and in other ways it’s not as bad. These curses will combine though, making the threats that come for you far more unpleasant.

objects.title: Dorkish Persona
objects.text: The cut of a stylish hero will be lost to you, your manner of speech, stance, and general air outside of combat being that of an oafish goon, bumbling about unseriously. This can lead to underestimation, advantageous or otherwise, from those who don’t know you, while romantically, you’ll be ‘adorkable’ at best.

objects.title: Unwelcome
objects.text: You will give off an undefinable wrongness that will rub people the wrong way. If you appear weak, they may attack and take advantage, strong and they may fear you, normal and they will keep you at arm’s length. Can be countered with charisma, but your first impression will always be bad.

addons.text: Dorkish Persona: People may feel that you’re putting on an act to lower others guards, or that you’re irritatingly pathetic and snivelling. The effect will linger long after your first impression.

objects.title: Forgettable
objects.text: Your passing will be harder to remark, your legend never quite sticking. While your enemies and friends will not forget you, the common folk of the world will, and so all the fortunes and foibles of fame will escape you. Even those directly impacted will associate your actions with a ‘mysterious stranger’ type.

objects.title: Reputation Dependent
objects.text: Your reputation will determine your actions as opposed to the other way around. If people know you as strong, capable, and dependable, that is what you will be. If they see you as a slut, or an incompetent clown, or a vicious murderer of children, those are the actions you’ll be drawn to.

addons.text: This essentially makes you weak to propaganda, and while you can shift and manage your persona, letting it snowball until you’re seen as invincible, reality and rumour can soon bring you down to size. Those who wish to ruin your reputation may become your biggest threat, yet you can always hide and let the rumours die down to regain your sense of self.
Dorkish Persona: You are near guaranteed to be seen as a fool, and as a result your foolish manner will worsen significantly.
Forgettable: While the diluted reputations of the masses will not affect you, the opinions of those close to you will affect you far more.

objects.title: Misfortune
objects.text: A lingering bout of bad luck will follow you around. While not enough to outright kill you or deliver you into dire straits, it will make sure that the situations you encounter will always chance a worse outcome, your gambles losing both in combat and in play. Caution can temper the worst of this.

addons.text: Luck: You will have frustrating bouts of great and terrible luck, shifting at random. One day fortune will smile, the next, everything will go wrong.

objects.title: Demonic Contract
objects.text: Your soul is deal linked to a demon, by your will or someone else’s, and thus your body belongs to them for short periods, roughly an hour every two weeks. They can let this time build up to control you longer, and the control can be instructions you must follow, or outright possession at a cost of half the time.

addons.text: You’ll be aware of the control always as the demon will appear before you to interact. As they don’t want your contract to be found out (you would be rejected and cast out by society), they will only do this in private. The actions may be sexual, destructive, or advancing to the demonic agenda. The demon will be both male and female, interchangeably or at the same time. Destroying the demon will require great personal sacrifice.

objects.title: Contract Abidance
objects.text: Any contract, oath, or guarantee, be it spoken, signed, or nodded to, will be one that you must obey. Failure to uphold your end will result in weakening and a greater susceptibility to the contractors suggestions for between one and one hundred years, depending on how vehemently you agreed.

addons.text: While most dangerous with strongly binding demon contracts, where both parties are trying to con the other, carelessness in what you say is the biggest threat. Someone asking you not to hurt anyone can leave you defenceless with an absent minded nod. You’ll be aware of what you have agreed to and can be released from it by the contract holder, but their death will bind you to it until it’s done.
As a Resident: Oaths you inherit, from honour bound duty to a slave’s service, will not count unless you agree to them again.
Demonic Contract: The demon cannot sign you up for further contracts and what it makes you agree to is not binding, but you won’t be able to destroy or subvert the demon you’re bound to.

objects.title: Corrupted Being
objects.text: Your demonic blood is of the rare strength to consume your non-demonic side. You will progressively become more monstrous in form, and even in mind, cruel thoughts creeping in. As you’ll inevitably turn full demon, you’ll be treated as such by any who find out your condition.

objects.title: Cursed Spot
objects.text: A visible mark will appear somewhere on your body that will impart pain and weakness upon you. Attacks directly upon it will bypass many of the defences you may have, causing great agony and potentially fatal injury, regardless of healing. It will be small, but it will throb with hurt from time to time.

addons.text: This will not be on any place conventionally visible, such as the face or hands. It can also be healed, provided a great ritual takes place, which will carry a great cost of its own. It can also be made worse by masters of curse magic.
Pain Control: You can avoid the pain that comes with this, but not the vulnerability.

objects.title: Hero’s Journey
objects.text: You will begin mostly normal, your gifts only weak potentials that increase with experience. Any knowledge chosen will be academic and entirely unpractised, any immunities you have will require exposure to properly coalesce, and your stats will shift from average to your selection over time.

addons.text: After approximately two years of hard adventure, you will be at the power peak you’d have without this, though the more skills you have, the longer it will take to train each of them. Your curses and weaknesses will be with you in full from the start.

objects.title: Burden of Keys
objects.text: A curse more common than people realise, hidden due to how few will actually acquire a key in their lifetime. You’ll need double the normal amount of keys -twelve instead of six- to have any hope of acquiring the powers. With skill, patience, and many years of a long life, it will be possible, and legendary.

objects.title: Soulless
objects.text: Immunity to any and all soul magic, but without a soul, there will be nowhere you can be marked with keys, and thus no possible way of collecting the powers of the Dreamers Trophies. Fair points for one who has no desire for such things.

addons.text: You’ll face no outward change, nor mental change, but some people may sense an absence about you. Dealing with gods and demons will be harder, and there will be no natural reincarnation either, leaving the death of your new life forever permanent.
Twisted Reincarnation: While death is usually permanent without a soul, this will allow you to return as an undead only once, though likely a very unusual one.

objects.title: Poverty or Death
objects.text: Wealth will get you killed. Your health will deteriorate relative to the worth of coins, jewels, and personal property associated with you. Only the practical equipment you carry and use on your person will not be counted, so you can have an expensive sword, but you cannot mount it on your wall.

addons.text: The deterioration is a slow one, both in decreasing and recovering. You won’t keel over dead if someone gave you a castle, but you would die after a month or so if you still had it. Property you own but don’t know about doesn’t count until you do. Other people cannot ‘hold your stuff’, but you can give them what you have to keep for themselves.

objects.title: Death on your Heels
objects.text: The fateful spectre of death will follow you like a miasma, trailing calamity in your wake. Wars, ambushes, and unhappy accidents, all happen when you are no longer nearby. While you yourself will not die because of this, others may associate you with an ill omen because of it, denying you and your trailing shadow sanctuary.

addons.text: Expect a lot of friends, acquaintances, and allies to die should you leave them behind.

objects.title: Death in Time
objects.text: Without the powers, you will die. Death of your body, dissolution of your spirit, destruction of your material being, all happening 10 years after your arrival. Most cannot get all the keys within their lifetime, but you are not most, and perhaps power enough will let you thunder to the finish. If nothing else, this provides a great motivation.

addons.text: Rebirth or Twisted Reincarnation: While useful if dying before your time runs out, they will not save you from this curse activating. In the case of reincarnation, only losing all powers may save you, and for rebirth, the timer will resume when you do.
Burden of Keys: A near impossible task made even more impossible. Sprinting through so many hard quests in such a short amount of time would leave you a legend.

rows.title: Sexualised Curses
rows.titleText: Again, your mind slips to its hot parts, even in the darkest of deliberations. Deviant banes that could commit you to actions, or limit your movements. Things done by yourself, or to others, or by others upon you. The combinations are briefly endless, their nuances intriguing, but you shake the majority off. Your considerations must be far more tempered, and far less distracting.

objects.title: Impotence
objects.text: It will take a lot more to get a rise from you, at least in your loins. While there are alchemists who can give a temporary reprieve, and while you can experience arousal and pleasure, it will be harder to satisfy those waiting for a stiff and sizable entrance.

objects.title: Size Queen
objects.text: You have a hole that cannot be easily filled. Only the largest of insertions will bring any pleasure, the smaller kind bringing only disappointment. This is all relative. You can even start average, but the bigger you experience, the more anything smaller than it will fail to satisfy.

addons.text: Tight: This may quickly leave you risking physical injury just to find pleasure.

objects.title: Hymen Healing
objects.text: Regeneration in all the wrong places. Once your hymen is torn it will reform two hours after, unless the space is otherwise occupied. Expect such sex to be painful and bloody near every time. Despite what your partner may think, and all things being physically restored, this does not re-make you a virgin for magical purposes.

addons.text: One upside of this is that it comes with general genital healing, so you’ll be back to ‘normal’ after even the most traumatic of insertion. It may take a little longer, and your mind isn’t included, but you’ll heal physically. Curse is suspended while pregnant.

objects.title: Forever a Virgin
objects.text: A very minor curse, and can be seen as a positive. Seven days after sex, you will be considered a virgin again. Nothing changes physically, but for ritual purposes and magical identification, you’ll meet the criteria. This is a curse as most rituals that need virgins don’t end so well for the virgin.

addons.text: There are some positive rituals of renewal that require virgins, and some empowering rituals that take virginity, though most gods will not be pleased if tricked by multiple losses. Cultists who find out about this may try to kidnap you, to reuse you in the more rapacious rituals.

objects.title: Orgasmic Fog
objects.text: When you are brought to orgasm, a mind fog will descend, inebriating your decision making abilities and temporarily reducing your intelligence by about ten percent for several hours. This does stack, both in loss and in time, with multiple successive orgasms potentially leaving you comatose for weeks.

addons.text: Strong Orgasms: The effect will be doubled.
Post-coital Suggestion: In the sweet spot of the fog, where intelligence is reduced only slightly, suggestions will be more effective and long lasting.

objects.title: Post-coital Suggestion
objects.text: When you are brought to orgasm, your mind will be open to suggestion, leaving you blissfully following any instructions given for an hour after. Too many orgasms in a short period will be like high level mind control, potentially adding permeant ticks and the change or loss of memory if instructed.

addons.text: Strong Orgasms: The effect will be doubled.
Orgasmic Fog: The fog can provide some protection from suggestions if you’re too dumb to understand the words or meanings spoken.

objects.title: Clothing Mishaps
objects.text: Little wardrobe accidents will creep into your life, leaving you far more likely to be exposed by some unfortunate tear or breeze. The damage of combat, the wear of a long journey, or the dastardly snaring power of a wayward door handle, will all become your enemy, and the wind will be ever vigilant in making it worse.
