addons.text: Armoured Combat: This is rarer with heavy armour, but more crippling when it happens. ‘Skimpy’ armour can help alleviate this.

objects.title: Forced Nudity
objects.text: You cannot cover your vital organs or exposed genitals, and the rest of you cannot bear more than a little coverage. This does mean you can wear things like enchanted rings, gauntlets, and boots, but the rest of you must be naked. This can make adventuring in the cold north decidedly difficult.

objects.title: Incontinence
objects.text: Your bladder cannot be contained and will leak from time to time without any input from yourself. How you deal with this and its consequences will be up to you, as while there may be some creative solutions in terms of dealing with the output, you cannot stop the core problem from occurring.

addons.text: Perfect Metabolism: You will not need to urinate generally, but that will not prevent these attacks of incontinence from occurring.
Endurance > 18: Not drinking any fluids at all may help to prevent this, or at least make it rarer.

objects.title: Desirable
objects.text: You will be seen as an object for sex by anyone sexually active. While some may consider this a blessing, the first thought people have of you being your physical use will leave them will little consideration for your feelings, deeds, or personality. Their every word will be to get you into their bed.

addons.text: Sexual Pheromones: While Pheromones act as a local modifier, this bane remains long after your absence. Combined, people in your vicinity will be putty in your hands, willing to do anything for you to get a taste of what you offer. A powerful ability, but good luck making any real friends.

objects.title: Defilable
objects.text: Your sexual lure takes on a victims edge, your aura tempting anyone of even morally neutral proclivities to ravish you, regardless of your own desires. From groping and cornering up to kidnapping and rape, the perpetrators alone or in organised groups. You will be synonymous with a dark temptation.

addons.text: Remember that this will draw both men and women or all races, though as men by and large have less control of their libido, you may face more of them. This will not turn all into beasts; the virtuous and strong willed can resist. Hiding your face and body from site, or wearing disguises can help.

Male: Do not think that being a strong intimidating man will keep others away; people will touch and grope, and lick, and bite, and be far rougher with you, knowing or believing that you can take and deserve it.

objects.title: Sexually Unwholesome
objects.text: A great many of the unwholesome situations you stumble into will also be sexual. The transport of sex slaves, sexual assaults, humiliating punishments in progress, bandits and kidnappers with the worst of intentions, ‘allies’ that ask you to join them so that they might take advantage. Abusers and the abused will litter your path.

addons.text: As with its component parts, this is not aimed at you, but is merely situations you encounter. That’s not to say you cannot or will not get caught up in them. Indeed, it will be hard not to.

The number of ‘situations’ remains the same, so you can choose how to balance this. Perhaps all sexual situation are dark, and thus less relationship drama, or all the dark situations have a sexual air.

objects.title: Need to Breed
objects.text: Your body will have an excessive need to produce offspring. This is no mental change, but a hormonal one, flushing and flustering you in the presence of those compatible to the task, your body aching to achieve its biological purpose regardless of your sexual preferences.

addons.text: Beauty and personality have little connection to fertility, and so your body may pull you towards the compatible even if you mentally find them repulsive. You’ll nevertheless feel a strong incentive to comply.
Dick: The sight, sound, and smell of fertile, impregnatable women, even if repulsive both outside and in, will get you harder than anything else, and hold your unwilling eyes for longer.

Pussy: The sight, sound, and musky smell of men who carry strong seed, will leave you flush in cheeks and loins. It won’t matter if they’re weak slips, fat slabs, or emotionally stunted brutes you would never go near. Your body wants them inside you.
Greater Fertility: The effect of this is increased significantly and can be very dangerous if you want to remain childless.
No Fertility: While you may not be able to actually have children, your body will still do its best to make you try.
Fertility Control: While you may have the final say on if you can have children, your body has decided that right now is the best time to try.

objects.title: Self-restraint
objects.text: Pleasuring yourself will be off the table, with any touch upon any part of yourself made with the intention of sexual satisfaction bringing only physical pain and mental dizziness. Extends to magical and prosthetic touch you control. You will need the touch of others to satisfy your bodies’ sexual cravings.

addons.text: Masochistic: Instead of bringing pain, you will instead feel nothing, your touch numbing yourself.

objects.title: Abstinence
objects.text: No carnal act with another will satisfy your sexual urges. Doing so will bring only pain, discomfort, and nausea, and while you can still physically do so, you’ll gain no satisfaction from it, and will be left extremely flustered. You will need to rely on your own touch to quench your sexual needs, though tools and spells you control can help.

addons.text: Self-restraint: Unable to touch or be touched, you will find yourself unable to sexually satisfy yourself by any means.

objects.title: Timeless Arousal
objects.text: Any sexual arousal that builds within you will not calm down over time, lingering until it is satisfied. Once your body finds relief, your arousal can diminish naturally, down to zero, before building again without dropping. While your physical state cannot be controlled, a strong will can safeguard your mental faculties.

addons.text: Self-restraint and Abstinence: Unable to satisfy your ever building arousal, you may just go insane. You’ll need an iron will to keep moving forward.

objects.title: Close Curses
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: Weaknesses
rows.titleText:
Unlike curses that must be lived with and worked around, weaknesses are vulnerabilities open to attack, be it from people, nature, or opposition of all kinds. They are constant companions, each desperate to be the one that stabs you in the back. This is not the gaining of additional burdens so much as it is a lessoning of your physical self, and may quickly lead to your end should you approach your foes with any overconfidence. 

Fortunately, you have some control over the distribution of such weaknesses. The amount may remain the same, but, for instance, you may be somewhat weak to all magic, or incredibly weak to just one school. Very weak to Goblins, or generally weak to anything brutish and uncivilised.

You shouldn’t think for a moment there is a way around this though. If you choose some single thing supposedly beneficial, like blessings for magic, or positive holy gods, they may be so effective against you as to be horrifically dangerous, a boost in strength turning you into a mass of quivering muscles. Unwitting allies may become your worst enemies.

And finally, these are additive. Should to be weak to magic, weapons, and women, a woman welding a magic weapon will be considerably more dangerous to you than any of those things apart.

objects.title: Elemental
objects.text: A weakness to the elements and the wild nature of the world. The sun will dry you out, the wind will push you back, and in water, you’ll sink link a stone. While this extends to elemental magic, it is mostly just being less hardy to the wild world, catching colds, overheating, twisting ankles on rocks. Always low level, save in bad environments, but ever-present, at least outside of cities.

objects.title: Weapons
objects.text: The sharp edge of a blade will cut you deeper, and the blunt force of a mace will break bones more easily. Any mundane weapon will remain deadly to you, which will perhaps be no great leap for a magic type, but will be harsh for any up close fighter. Armour is less effective, and even magic shields can be cut through by lesser creatures.  Enchanted weapons will be unaffected by this.

objects.title: Magic
objects.text: You’re susceptible to all spells, curses, enchanted items, and magical fields of all kinds. For magic, your bodies aura is like air to flame, making the spells cast against you burn brighter. Even friendly spells, while more powerful on you, will be wilder, risking side effects from their empowerment. Magic is not common, nor ever easy to face, but for you it will be particularly risky.

addons.text: Will only effect scholarly, natural, and fey magic. The divine magic of the heavens or the infernal magic that beats in demonic veins, will gain no particular advantage against you from this.

objects.title: Possession
objects.text: No matter your will, no matter your intellect or resistances, you are wide open to possession. Spirits, be they confused, benign, or pure evil malice, can possess your body for a time, draining themselves in the process. Powerful spirits may take a day within to diminish themselves, while weaker ones only a few seconds.

addons.text: Fully diminished spirits are more likely to move on or be banished, though some of the smarter ones may end their possession sooner so they can haunt you again. While it won’t feel like it, this is a good thing as you’ll be of service to the spiritual world. Some may even help you.
Soul Interventions or Spirit Contracting: Divine skills over spirits can help alleviate this curse, turning your body into a crucible of spiritual purging, or keeping the worst at bay.
Mind Control Immunity: Instead of being unconscious during possession, you keep your mind, watching through your own eyes and communicating thoughts to the spirit controlling your body.

objects.title: Monsters
objects.text: Any questing adventurer of the world will encounter monsters, those with claws or brutal strength, either beast folk or green kin or more savage fair, like chimeras and great beasts. Their blows will land harder, their skin will be tougher, and unless taking the fight with extreme seriousness, you may be left to their merciless attentions.

objects.title: Undead
objects.text: The necrotic energies of the undead, be it a ghostly touch, a remorseless strike, or the undivine magic’s of a necromancer, will overwhelm, hitting harder and faster against you than against others. You’ll be less able to cut their leather flesh, or break their ossified bones, and must be judicious should you ever have to fight them.

objects.title: Holy
objects.text: Many demons and undead are weak to celestial influences, with divine magic cutting through them, banishing and harming them greatly. With this, the gods have an almost direct line to you, with attack miracles, rebuking, and even light magic working similarly. On the upside, blessings cast by others will also be more effective on you, but spiritual coercions will as well.

addons.text: Will Reversal: To those who subjugate themselves to the divine will of the gods, this may be seen as more of a blessing than a curse.

objects.title: Demons
objects.text: Demons have rules of their own, and powers. Their evil energies will be a particularly effective weapon against you, whether stoking sin and temptation, weakening with corruptive influence, or simply overpowering you with demonic form. All attacks will cut through your defences, physical, magical, and spiritual, with disturbing ease, leaving you extra vigilant around them.

objects.title: Otherworldly
objects.text: The creatures and forces of ‘unnatural’ worlds will have power over you. The whispers of deep river cultists and their dark outer gods will cut through your mental defences, while creatures of dreams, the golem guards of Dormientes, and otherworldly intrusions neither divine nor demonic, will sap you of strength and courage.

addons.text: Dreamworld: The creatures of the dream world will be far harder to deal with, and more bold in their animosity.

objects.title: Men
objects.text: Any who carry the honest appearance of the male sex will have an advantage against you. Their strength will leave you unnerved, their capabilities assumed high; you’ll grow tense and much of your strength will diminish when facing them as foes. This may be the males of the civilised races, or of all species, or of just one.

addons.text: This must include your own race as a minimum, and if it is only males of that race, they will have an easy time beating you. Spreading it out among all species will give the weakest effect.

objects.title: Women
objects.text: Any who look sincerely female will have an advantage against you. Their whiles will have you subconsciously drop your guard, leaving you flustered and unable to fight as you otherwise could no matter how you chastise yourself. This can be for all or one of the civilised races, or anything that appears remotely feminine.

addons.text: This must include your own race as a minimum, though if it is only women of that race, they will beat you with ease. For some hairier species, you may not recognise them as women, but they still are.
Men & Women: In other words, people. This leaves all members of the civilised races with an advantage against you.

objects.title: The Strong of Will
objects.text: Conflict is inevitable, both on and off the trail to the powers. While most fight for survival or improving their meagre lot, some fight for causes, be they lone trails of revenge and redemption, or great endeavours of which they are only a small part. Such people, when standing against you, will stand firmer than any might think possible, winning by wanting it more.

addons.text: Beware if chosen with rivals as many of them will possess a steadfast quality that helps them stand above.

rows.title: Sacrifices
rows.titleText:
True loss beckons, with your new form ripe for the harvest. Abandoning the task of weakening yourself, you cut to the act of sacrifice, choosing what to lose and never regain by conventional means. Like with all curses, these sacrifices will be lost upon gaining the trophies, though in the case of these, what you lose will be waiting for you alongside the powers of the dreamer.

You take a look at the form you’ve blessed yourself with. Meat under a butchers eyes.

objects.title: Blindness
objects.text: The loss of sight. A usually fatal disadvantage for those prone to adventure, but can be mitigated with perceptions beyond light, and can even protect against sights that strike the mind.

addons.text: You can keep your eye colour, or cloud it with white, or have no eyes at all. Supersedes eye-choice.
As a Resident: You’ll either have this from birth, your life adapted around it, or be more recently blinded, perhaps being helped to acclimatise more, but facing pity and an upturned existence.

objects.title: Deafness
objects.text: The loss of hearing. A silent world can be a frightening one, and lonely, muted of music and laughter. A less obvious disability that can leave a greater appreciation for your other senses.

addons.text: This does grant a certain immunity to sound magic, and a more destructive boost to it if you learn it, but also much less nuanced control.
Know the Words: You’ll still know the language, accessible through reading lips, and you’ll still be able to speak it, though not hear yourself doing so.

As a Resident: You’ll can either be adapted to this from birth, carrying a strange way of speaking and a lip-reading ability, or be more recently deafened, carrying a more natural language, but less adapted in friends and lifestyle.

objects.title: Anosmia
objects.text: The loss of your sense of smell. Depending on where you are, this can be a blessing, though still a blindness of its own. Particularly problematic for alchemists and bestial types.

objects.title: Ageusia
objects.text: The loss of your sense of taste. There are many fine foods to try, but some not so fine things you’d otherwise wish to avoid. Both can be as welcome on your tongue as anything else.

objects.title: Hypoesthesia
objects.text: The numbing of your sense of touch. Everything will feel muted, as though far away, and while this diminishment may keep you from pain, save in extremes, it will keep you from pleasure as well.

addons.text: Any Body Sensitivity: The chosen places will be of normal sensitivity, unmatched to your otherwise numb self.

objects.title: Prosopagnosia
objects.text: The loss of recognising faces. Peoples age and gender will be harder to determine, and even dear friends will appear as strangers in appearance, unless you can recognise them in other ways.

addons.text: Blindness: Becomes a difficulty recognising voices, which may be far more debilitating to you.

objects.title: Amusia
objects.text: The loss of musical understanding; tone deafness; blindness to rhythm. Makes dancing impossible, music an irritation, and can disrupt your sense of flow in combat.

addons.text: Deafness: While already without sound, this can close you off to the sensing of vibrations. Footsteps, and other worldly beats, will be impossible to differentiate and understand, and your internal rhythm will still be disrupted.

objects.title: Dromosagnosia
objects.text: The loss of your sense of direction, confusing spatial relationships between places. Makes navigating even moderate distances or mildly complex spaces impossible without help.

addons.text: Memory: Your talent for memory will not extend to the paths between places.

Navigation: Your skills of navigation can help counter this on a large scale, assuming you can see the stars or have a compass. Every pathway will be like the first time taken, and recognising when you’ve been turned around will be easier.
Dimensional Magic: Spatial creation magic does risk you losing your way in your own constructed spaces, but portal magic will help you get from one place to another without walking any roads.

objects.title: Muteness
objects.text: The ability to speak words, or voice any utterance at all, will be lost. This will make communicating with all around you much more difficult.

addons.text: Sound Magic: While usually vocalised, it can be wrought from the raw air. It’s harder to do, but with talent and practice, it may be possible to make a crude voice from this.

objects.title: Limb Loss
objects.text: The loss of a limb. This can be selected multiple times, each sacrificing either an arm or a leg of your choice, either in totality or just functionality. The former may allow for some expensive magical replacement, while the latter can retain feeling.

objects.title: Close Vulnerabilities
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: Sleep Disorders
rows.titleText: As you aim to step out of your dreaming state and into a world tied so closely with the fevers of the resting mind, you realise the break needn’t be so abrupt, and that the lines between need not be so stark. Dreams can so easily become nightmares themselves after all, and what cleaner way to find the balance you seek? Dreams are, after all, a great vulnerability, both within, and without.

objects.title: Need More Sleep
objects.text: While the needed amount of sleep varies slightly between species, and the time you can go without sleep depends on your endurance, the average healthy amount is eight hours. With this, it will be more like twelve for you, increasing by half. While you can endure with less, you will be more tired, and fatigue will set in sooner as your energy levels drain.

objects.title: Heavy Sleeper
objects.text: Once asleep, it will be hard to wake you, save with significant injury. Only upon finishing your rest will you wake up normally, and as such, it will mean hours of being extremely vulnerable, where others can move, molest, or even attack without you waking. It will be necessary to invest in trusted security before sleeping.

addons.text: Need More Sleep: You’ll be harder to wake for longer, with the deepest middle period being most increased in duration.

objects.title: Insomnia
objects.text: This greatly increases the difficulty of falling sleep of your own accord, requiring greater tiredness before you’re able to do so. Naturally, this will leave you tired throughout much of your waking time, and may require drugs to get a full night’s sleep, preventing you from waking after the bare minimum time.

addons.text: Heavy Sleeper: While it will be hard to go to sleep, this combination means that when you get there, you stay there until you’re done.

objects.title: Narcolepsy
objects.text: Your sleep schedule is disrupted, with you falling asleep at random times not of your choosing. These sleep attacks can result in confusion and a tiredness that hinders concentration. While unlikely to happen when your life is in danger, it can leave you embarrassed and vulnerable to others, especially if you’re a heavy sleeper.

addons.text: Less Sleep Needed: You will still randomly fall asleep, waking only when rested or awoken by something. This may happen slightly less often.
No Sleep Needed: You will still randomly fall asleep, waking only when awoken by something. As you don’t need to rest, you may find yourself sleeping for a long time.

Heavy Sleeper: It will be harder to wake you when a bout of sleep strikes, but not impossible, especially if done soon after you drift off. If left long enough for real sleep to happen, you’ll get the full effect, resting until rested.

objects.title: Sleep Paralysis
objects.text: Sometimes, halfway between asleep and awake, you will be unable to move, suffocated, trapped at the halfway mark. Your eyes will see strange waking dreams against which you are defenceless, and all the powers you have -your strength of body, your magic knowledge- will be beyond your reach, leaving only discomfort and fear.

addons.text: This will happen anywhere between once a week to once every few months, blurring the line between dreaming and wakefulness.
No Sleep Needed: This will happen every time you choose to fall asleep.

objects.title: Paralysis Demon
objects.text: Your paralysed moments grow even worse, the vague semi-dream becoming a consistent nightmare that manifests an evil feeling presence. Sometimes it watches, far or close, and sometimes it climbs atop you, standing or lying, adding to your fear and breathlessness. In a world of demons and spirits, it may be more than your imagination.

objects.title: Sexual Paralysis
objects.text: The strange visions of the half sleep now impart some sexual act upon you, varying in type, sometimes just felt and sometimes matching the hallucinations received. While this may be considered a boon, others will notice the loud moaning you’ll make, and you’re likely to wake up having made quite the mess.

addons.text: Paralysis Demon: The nightmarish presence that comes to you when you cannot move is now the perpetrator of the sexual acts. Without your consent, these molestations will feel sharply real and brutally vicious, yet the morning will show your body is unstained, save by your own productions.

objects.title: Sleep Naked
objects.text: The only chance you’ll have to sleep will be if you do so naked as wearing any clothes will feel constricting and will simply stop your mind from drifting off. While this can be used to ward off sleep, doing so for too long will drive you insane. Blankets can still cover you, but they must be loose and unsecured.

addons.text: Heavy Sleeper: You’ll be left both unarmoured and utterly defenceless.

objects.title: Dream Horrors
objects.text: Your dreams will occasionally be stricken with unnatural nightmares, feeling real, and inescapable even upon realising they are dreams. These are far more intense than any normal nightmare, of which you’re still susceptible. Dying in the dream will be the only sure way to wake from it, outside of surviving to its conclusion.

addons.text: Heavy Sleeper: Dying will no longer wake you, but the unnatural nightmare will still end, turning to a dream, or more likely a regular nightmare.
Less Sleep Needed: Your dreams will be more often stricken by nightmares, to compensate for the reduced opportunities.

objects.title: Wet Nightmare
objects.text: The nightmares you may have will be stricken with a sexual energy that does not elevate them into anything fair or fine. Cruel taboos will be broken by you and with you, and they will leave you as unsettled as they will flustered, their real feeling lingering into wakefulness. You’re less likely to die within them, but less likely to wake early as a result.

objects.title: Personalised Nightmares
objects.text: The unnatural nightmares that assail you in sleeping are usually divorced from your mind, like an external tormentor, its monsters and its intensities working on anyone. Now the horrors will be made for you, as dreams are, manifesting your personal fears, acquaintances and familiar places. Worse, but at least you may learn something of yourself.

addons.text: The opponents you’ll face become beatable, conquered by confronting something difficult within yourself, but at the same time, the traumas they can inflict can be much more cutting. Expect to wake up crying far more often than winning.
Wet Nightmare: The sexual nightmares will be personal to you, cutting to your fears and insecurities and casting people you know as both perpetrator and victim, sullying your impressions of them.

objects.title: Easy Knock Out
objects.text: Yours is a head susceptible to the soporific effects of blunt force trauma. While you will not gain the brain damage associated with such things, being rendered unconscious will come easily, leaving you fast asleep with what may be only a glancing blow, and delivering all the misfortunes of dreams as you have otherwise chosen.

addons.text: No Sleep Needed: As your need for rest will have no effect, the unconsciousness will last for half an hour unless woken by something else.
Heavy Sleeper: You’ll be asleep longer and be harder to wake. People may assume you’re dead.
Insomnia: You may begin to see this as a painful, yet effective, solution to your problem.
Sleep Paralysis: You will never suffer paralysis going down, but if allowed to wake naturally, it may happen when you’re coming around.

objects.title: Dreamworld Closer
objects.text: Realities skin just got thinner, the dark dream-realm that manages the containment of the trophies now pushing uncomfortably close. Their shifting shadows will slither at the seams, the corners of your vision catching them mocking and perverting the world. With their new proximity, spell and ritual may grant you access to them, and them to you.

addons.text: The dreamworld is a twisted dark mirror of the real one, and contains the consensuses that maintain the protections of the trophies. Such beings will become hostile if learning you quest for them, but you may barter for details on the keys if you’re cunning, and learn esoteric knowledge about ancient history, inside and outside of reality.

Dreamworld Access: With the dreamworld so close, you may be drawn into it by accident from time to time, sometimes in dream and sometimes in reality, the lines between both quickly blurring. Leaving will be harder as well.

objects.title: Sexualised Dreamworld
objects.text: The already frightening and dangerous dreamworld changes with your entry, not becoming, but having always been a sexualised place dripping with desire. Its once cold and barren landscape now pulses with wet heat, its cutting wind now a moaning sigh, its dangers shifting from life ending to things far more sordid.

addons.text: Dreamworld Closer: The sexualised shadow will ooze lusts behind the scenes, which may cause very minor bouts of sexual energies about you.

objects.title: Denizens Owed
objects.text: The ‘people’ of the dreamworld will no longer treat you as an unwelcome traveller, but more as a debtor, your every step on their domain leaving them owed. To deal with, or even talk to one of them, you’ll need to give them something. Knowledge, service, property, allegiance, control. The prices, while manageable, will always feel steep.

addons.text: This greatly increases the difficulty of the already difficult task of getting powerful and advantageous knowledge out of the underlying realm. Bartering can be aided by charisma, intelligence, will, and other negotiating bonuses. If they believe you’re after the trophies, they will not bargain.
Dreamworld Closer: Deals made can now require actions in the waking world to fulfil, the denizens now able to watch you from the shadows, making sure you uphold your side of any bargain.
Sexualised Dreamworld: The deals and debts will now require more erotic payment, which you may find easier, but will still be steep.

objects.title: Invading Influence
objects.text: The beings that live in the hard dream, whose influences truly safeguard the trophies, will now be able to enter your new world on their own, targeting those who seek the trophies and influencing events to make them even harder to acquire. They will be the most shadowed antagonists, behind assassins, misfortunes, and many distractions.

addons.text: After your first key is acquired, it will be very difficult (though not impossible) to convince them you’re not after the trophies. After three keys, they will not believe it and you will become one of their prime targets. Fighting against their influence will hard, but their methods often have some weakness.

objects.title: Sleep Walker
objects.text: There are some whose dreams leave them walking, the number increasing nearer to Dormientes. While some wonder aimlessly, others pursue crude goals, or can be caught like leaves upon a river, flowing in a direction of which they are ignorant, controlled by powers they can’t comprehend. Some are never seen again, or wake in strange or dangerous places.

addons.text: Need More Sleep: The longer you sleep, the more likely you will be subject to such forces, and the further they will take you once snared.
Heavy Sleeper: While sleep walkers can and should be woken, it will be hard for anyone to snap you out of it.
Easy Knock Out: You will not sleep walk from being knocked out, unless you remain sleeping for some time.

Dreamworld Closer: While usually the occult creatures of other worlds, or the dream manipulations of malicious spirits or bad actors, it can now also be the beings and bodies of the dream world that moves susceptible sleepers.

objects.title: Sleep Life
objects.text: Those susceptible to sleep walking usually walk with the obvious shuffling gate of mindless movements, but you will appear awake and completely normal to those around you, pursuing things you subconsciously want to. Should you be controlled by otherworldly influence, they will have access to your power and skill, only slightly diminished.

objects.title: Close Dreams
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: Mental Decay
rows.titleText:
Your mind is a terrible thing to sacrifice, usually not to be thrown into the headwinds of a wild abandon. Interesting people do often have some quirk to them, yet in terms of personality, there is a far and subtle divide between different and difficult, stimulating and sickening, interesting and insanity. What extra edge will you take?

Be careful, as while a broken body can be circumvented by a crafty mind, a broken mind may not be so fortunate. Your goals will remain the same, but your path to power may be as straight as an arrows flight, or as chaotic as an explosions debris, and while your mental calm may be one of the many thing waiting for you with the trophies, it will be useless if you can never think to get there. 

With enough will, some of these may be powered through; with enough wisdom, you may know yourself enough to live in harmony with your conditions; with enough intelligence, perhaps you could manipulate your broken parts, aiming them in the right direction. No matter what crutch you use, these are burdens you will never be truly free from, and they can turn you into you own worst enemy.

objects.title: Fearless
objects.text: Far less advantageous than it sounds, fear is the mother of caution: the voice that tells you to take it slow when danger is near. To cut this part out of you is to blind and deaden yourself, and for all it may launch you forward, fearless people often stop with sudden fatal ends, or learn the lessons that will be lost to you.

addons.text: More Unsure, Cautious, or Paranoid: With a personality prone to reserved action, you’re less likely to face the true dangers of fearlessness, the worst of this trait being balanced out.
More Confident, Adventurous, or Carefree: Already a wild card, your fearlessness will be greatly increased, propelling you into dangerous situations with considerable overconfidence.
Hides the next section.

objects.title: Anxious
objects.text: The creeping gnawing fear of things going wrong, either rising and falling in attacking waves, or lingering as a low level drone of incessant worry. While this may leave you better prepared to deal with issues as they arise, and more cautious in your dealings, many find the burden to be draining and disheartening.

addons.text: More Unsure, Cautious, or Paranoid: Already prone to fearful mentalities, this condition is increased in its severity, often crippling you at times and proving a great challenge to overcome.
More Confident, Adventurous, or Carefree: With a personality ill-suited to worry, you’ll be better able to overcome your anxiety and be less impeded from its presence.

objects.title: Bestial Rages
objects.text: There is a wild rage inside you that boils out once every month or more, lasting between an hour and a day. You’ll feel it coming and have time to prepare, but the more powerful you are, the harder you’ll be to contain and the more damage you’ll do to people, property, and your own reputation should you get out.

addons.text: Being a blind rage, this is mostly physical, though spells of will and rhetoric may be called down.

objects.title: Isolation Desire
objects.text: You have a need to be on your own, the company of others becoming a strong drain on your mental energies, your patience, and your calm. This will drive you into lonely situations it offers no comfort for and will make working with others very difficult, but if you can learn to lover your own company, this may not be so bad.

addons.text: More Distant: Already drained by company and prone to introversion, this will turn you into quite the recluse, unlikely to share words with anyone throughout your journey.
More Controlling: As an extroverted type, this will be particularly brutal, the social fuel you need turning into a bitter poison. Lonely with people. Lonely away from people. Forever conflicted.
A Mentor, Friend, Lover, or Party: These trusted people you encounter will know and understand your desire to be away from them. They’ll work around it.

objects.title: Truth Tied
objects.text: You may only communicate the truth, responding with what you believe matchs with reality as you see it. You can remain silent and lie by omission, though doing so will feel uncomfortable, leaving an itch in your mind that will fade over time. Covers words, letters, thought communication, hand signals, all of it.

addons.text: There will be some minor workarounds; if you tell someone you’re going to lie to them, you can lie. This can help when telling stories or singing songs. You can also lie to yourself, but not when you know others are listening.
Muteness: Without speech, the effects of this will not be felt as much.

objects.title: Lie Tied
objects.text: You may only communicate with lies. This will quickly become apparent to anyone who listens to you, so really, it’s more of an inconvenience to others to reverse what you say to try and find the truth. People will think there is something wrong with you. It is still possible to tell the truth by omission.

addons.text: Confusing contradictions are unaffected; for example, you can say ‘this statement is false’. Telling stories that are fiction can be done as well, even if they convey a truthful message; should the king kill his wife, you could not tell, but you could tell a story about a fictional king killing his wife just fine, with a little mental dexterity.
Muteness: Unable to speak, the effects of this on your daily life are also muted.
Tongue Tied: Attempting to speak, write, or otherwise communicate, will result in nothing but gibberish: a language that no mortal understands or recognises, save for yourself.

Tongue Tied: Attempting to write, act, or otherwise communicate in any way, will result in nothing but gibberish: a language that no mortal understands or recognises, but still recognisable as a language.

objects.title: Fading Dream
objects.text: As you step into the world and your new life, the choices made here will fade, slowly, falling apart the more you grasp for them, turning to fragments and then to nothing, leaving only the memory that you once knew... something. Writing it down quickly may help you save some scraps.

addons.text: The last thing to fade will be your knowledge of the trophies, lingering like a smoke outline and giving some minor purpose. Particularly traumatic arrivals will cause all memories to fade faster.

objects.title: Amnesia
objects.text: As the fire of forgetting consumes your dream memories, so too will it spread to your old life, erasing the memory of who you were. Your personality will remain, but your friends, family, name, and other identifying information will be gone. Perhaps a boon if you have no love for your old self.

addons.text: The dream fades first, your old life lingering for a time. You may not even notice what you don’t remember, until you try to remember it. The memories may be claimed with the powers, examined, and forgotten for good if you so choose.
Becoming Them: Your old memories will fade faster, your new ones taking their place. You’ll be a new person in truth.

objects.title: Complexity
objects.text: You will find yourself harder to understand, and thus harder to control. Introspection requires considerably more meditative time to gather less of a result, and insights that may be blatant to others, like why you are drawn to certain preferences and repulsed by others, will be a mystery to you. A boon for those wanting to manipulate your actions.

addons.text: This roughly halves your wisdom as it relates to yourself. Those not inclined to any introspection at all may not be bothered by this, but those with high intelligence will find it frustrating, their subconscious desires as difficult to connect with as a very autistic child.

objects.title: Gender Dysphoria
objects.text: Whatever the sex of your body, your mind disagrees. This miss-match will be more understandable if changing sex from what you were, but regardless, you’ll gravitate to another gender and seek to adopt their mannerisms. Spells, potions, and transformations may help, but your ‘true form’ will be remain wrong.

addons.text: Complexity: You inability to understand yourself will prevent you from knowing what you should be, leaving you wondering in a confused and often self-hating state, trying to be what you feel you’re not.

objects.title: Sexuality Denial
objects.text: You will be convinced that your chosen sexuality is wrong and will periodically try your opposite preferences, in genders, partners, and positions. This may be a constant forgetting, where you quickly realise your mistake, or a clueless denial, trying to convince yourself and others of the lie.

addons.text: This can be overpowered via a pleasurable encounter, but is likely to crop up again in time.

Complexity: This will stem from your complicated internal landscape, your subconscious essentially having a different sexual preference to your conscious mind. It will be harder to understand and appease.
Gender Dysphoria: This is more likely to manifest in a self-hatred, where you try to ‘convert’ yourself to what you believe your preferences should be through unpleasant exposure.

objects.title: Nymphomania
objects.text: Untethered from any physical arousal, you will be mentally drawn to and compelled into sexual activities with others. Giving into this compulsion will fulfil a need, be it restored feelings of control, or self-worth, or simply holding back a depression. While addictive in action and compulsion, a strong will may hold both at bay.

addons.text: Self Control: Yours is a mind-set built to contain, or at least control the flow, of such compulsions. You’ll be better able to choose how you satisfy this itch.
Less Control: Yours is a mind particularly susceptible to these demands. You’ll often find yourself in the beds of those you’d wish not to be associated with once your mind clears.
Sexuality Denial: This need will likely move back and forth between the genders of your preference and your denial, varying which will be able to scratch your mental itch.

objects.title: Pyromania
objects.text: An overwhelming compulsion towards fire. You love the sight, you love the sound, the warmth, the creeping destruction, the sudden engulfment, everything about it enthrals you. You’ll start fires on your own and you’ll be distracted by the fires you encounter. Putting them out will be difficult for you.

addons.text: Unlike real life pyromania, this is a condition elevated to extreme and addictive levels. Whether there is a sexual, suicidal, manic, or hypnotic component to the excitement is up to the fire, whatever that means.

Fire Casting: Skills in the elemental magic of fire can make this condition both infinitely easier to manage, and infinitely harder. You’ll start fires more often, but it’s significantly less likely you’ll harm yourself in them. Other people meanwhile…

objects.title: Gullibility
objects.text: The words of others are more likely to be received as truth as the filter within your mind that catches lies shrinks to anaemic thinness. While obvious sarcasms and absurdities are still caught, deceptions of any subtlety will catch you by surprise. You may wish to filter your information through a trusted friend.

objects.title: Guilt
objects.text: You will inevitably fail others, unable to save everyone, or even spare those you feel are deserving. The unavoidable horrors of the world will feel heavy on your shoulders, your powers the reason they could be stopped and your actions the reason they weren’t. It will take a strong will to push on at times.

addons.text: Every time someone dies or suffers terribly before you, where you didn’t try your hardest to help them individually, they will become a weight upon your soul, pushing you into bouts depression. Only by gaining the powers is this cumulative weight lifted, growing ever heavier until then. Can become debilitating.

More Empathetic: The weight you carry may quickly become crushing, but can be alleviated somewhat by empathising with those you have failed and doing a deed for them they would have thanked you for, helping their family or burying them respectfully, for example.

More Psychotic: The guilt upon your soul will not become a weight, instead adding to its fire and being consumed. Failing others acts as a drug that brings you bliss, the addiction to which can lead to a great difficulty in gaining and keeping the trust of anyone.

objects.title: Paranoia
objects.text: There will be many people ‘out to get you’ already, either faced when fetching keys, or threatened by your quest for power. With this, your mental list of enemies far more than doubles; each second look will be the makings of a plot, each paused sentence a bitten tongue, and each smiling person hiding a knife behind their back.

addons.text: More Paranoid: Paranoia is a strange thing. It is predestined to work against potential allies, and here, within your mind, is no different. The two types of distrust work against each other, meaning your primary paranoia is that perhaps you’re being too paranoid. The odd balance leaves you hyper aware and obsessive, with thoughts that often run in circles.

More Carefree: Your paranoia becomes something you are less aware of, and thus more able to take control of you subconsciously. People no longer might be plotting against you, in your mind they are, and are already your enemies, even if they’re not.

objects.title: Whispering Voices
objects.text: Your head will be plagued with schizophrenic whispers. While a sign of madness, in a world of gods and demons, spirits and spells, it can be a sign of much more. As they whisper things that you cannot have known, in voices you don’t recognise, there is a chance it’s the latter. It will take a long time to work out the truth.

addons.text: The words of the whisperers are seldom anything useful. Sometimes they overlap in a chorus of nonsense and sometimes they’re quiet for weeks. They rarely hold malice, seeming more like confused external observers.
Isolation Desire: The voices will offer no exceptions, coming and going as they may, making it harder to feel alone and recharge yourself.

objects.title: Evil Voices
objects.text: The voices compel you to do dark and cruel deeds, betraying, butchering, and desecrating, their truths more often life’s contradictions and the exploitable sad secrets of the seemingly kind.  With enough will and righteousness you can resist the actions they demand, but their words will remain, their perspectives lingering on you like a stain.

objects.title: Hallucinations
objects.text: The things your eyes see are not always real. People, places, creatures that cannot be, all glimpsed as though looking between the seams of reality. Most are benign; very rarely will you see something that makes your sweat cold. Easy to ignore, until one knocks something over, or a madman points at one unprompted.

addons.text: Like the whispers, whether the hallucinations are real or not, their source, their cure, will take a long time to work out, though they may be related. They cannot harm you, but can get so close, you think you can feel them.
Dreamworld Closer: Visions of the sleeping world will come to you more often and more blatantly, the two types of unreal seemingly in conflict.

objects.title: Madness
objects.text: Beset on all sides, your mind breaks. Fortunately for your quest and the expenditure of your abilities, you do not become the drooling and torpid kind of mad. Rather, you become the manic kind, kind or mordant or dolorous or raging, utterly divorced from your own self-control. It will be clear for all to see.

addons.text: Comes with immunity to mind control and resistance to any other kind of madness. Your methods will shift radically, often for the worse, but your general goal will remain the trophies, if it was before. Victory would bring a moment’s rare lucidity, and you could claim your mind back, should you want it.

More Controlled: You’re more likely to be the focused kind of mad, utterly obsessed with your goal and devoting every speck of your existence towards achieving it. Your madness may be harder to see at a surface reading.

More Unstable: You will be the maddest of the mad: an utterly unpredictable fireball of insanity, sometimes high enough to fight gods, sometimes low enough to scream in abject despair, and seemingly able to achieve the impossible at every turn.
Bestial Rages: Your rages will trigger more often and no longer be blind, using the full range of your abilities on the world around you.
Nymphomania: Your sexual appetites will be warped and all consuming, leaving scant times you’re not actively having sex, regardless of your partner’s willingness or even sentience.
Pyromania: The world must burn, and you will see it done!

rows.title: Phobias
rows.titleText:
The creeping mental poison of fear. All such things can be overcome and all such things can be gained through scarring experiences. For some, such as those chosen here, it is inherent, and overcoming it the greatest of challenges. For each of the phobias chosen below, you will be flush with fear, shaking, sweating, your attacks wild and your need to run pressing. Will and Wisdom can help to face such things, but they are crutches in the face of the heroic traits you truly need: courage and bravery. Hopefully, you are bringing such traits with you.

Your journey will not end upon your first encounter with the targets of your fears, unless said fears freeze you at the wrong time. Such opponents will not even be be foes you cannot overcome. This simply makes every time you face them a deeply unpleasant experience you’ll desperately not want to do. To conquer such a fear entirely would be a feat worthy of its own key, or two, if difficulty alone was the measure of such things. 

Fortunately, fear comes in many flavours, and while a general fear will be bad enough, you can choose to focus yours, perhaps to a single type of undead or beast folk. Beware though, as the total fear will remain the same. Reduce the potential targets of a category to its minimum and you may have a complete breakdown, or even a heart attack, upon finally encountering your phobias focus, while one who fears all instances of a thing will face a far more diluted effect.

objects.title: Claustrophobia
objects.text: Fear of confined spaces, getting stuck, and being trapped. This could be the pure inability to move, or being underground, or the press of a crowed, or simply the lack of an easy exit. From mild distress to pure panic depending how broad the condition. Not recommended for Dwarves or Drow, or any subsurface dweller.

objects.title: Agoraphobia
objects.text: Fear of open spaces, but also being beyond help and outside of safety and comfort, being lost, either alone or in the sea of a crowed, and being overwhelmed by all the things of the wide open world. Sufferers of this tend to stay home wherever possible, and thus it will be particularly debilitating for anyone longing for adventure.

addons.text: Claustrophobia: Afraid of the outside and the inside; the close and the far; only the place you call home, should it be spacious, will not fill you with dread. This can be quite debilitating.

objects.title: Aquaphobia
objects.text: Fear of water, be it great bodies and fast flowing rivers, to baths and showers, rains, and even drinking water. This fear extends to thalassophobia, or a fear of deep and dark waters and the unknown things within them, and also to creatures found within water, be they magic or mundane.

addons.text: Sea: With the breadth of Dormientes now an ocean, fearing the water will be a far greater burden.
Water Casting: You’ll have a compulsive need to control the water around you; if you don’t control it, your fear is heightened. Can help with exposure.

objects.title: Erotophobia
objects.text: Fear of sex and sexual organs. This comes in many kinds, from the reasonable dread of non-consensual attentions, to the fear born of inexperience, to those who find all sight and mention of sex to be terribly associated. Your choice, along with if you are drawn with conflicted morbidity to what you fear.

addons.text: Not a Virgin: This will be tied to a new and disturbing memory. It will be the experience that caused the fear, making it sharper and more bitter, but formed, and thus easier to conquer. The person or monster associated with this fear will still be alive: a difficult encounter to have.
Faster Heat: Your body’s natural desires are in conflict with your mind, adding a heavy dose of conflicted confusion and forbidden desire to your fears.
Slower Heat: Neither your mind nor your body really wants it, which will help to avoid it, but may leave you deprived entirely of the joys of sex.
Sexualised Magic’s: No so bad if done to yourself, though likely uncomfortable. Definitely bad if done to another. At least you’ll have plenty of chances for exposure therapy.

Nymphomania: Driven hard towards what you fear, you will either have a strong defence against your sexual compulsion, letting fear win and warp you, or you will conquer this phobia, giving in to sexual proclivities. Expect a difficult, confusing, and deeply unpleasant battle to be waged within you.

objects.title: Deprecophobia
objects.text: Fear of curses and the cursed. A not uncommon fear in a world of witches, vampires, and werewolves. Those who have it stray to hate and hunters groups, looking to destroy those who house and spread such curses, as well as themselves should they ever contract such a thing.

addons.text: Curse Knowledge OR Voodoo Magic: Like dealing with explosives, your own curses will be feared with healthy respect, and other peoples with sweating suspicion, leaving the great curses of the vampire and werewolf remaining strong an unsolvable.

objects.title: Necrophobia
objects.text: Fear of the dead, death, and of the undead. From the still and magicless skeleton to the shuffling bloody corpse. From ghostly possession to cool spiritual touches. Thankfully, this doesn’t apply so strongly to the deaths, or undeaths, you’ve been directly involved in, unless the body is left alone for some time.

addons.text: Terrifying Undead: While far more understandable and sympathetic, your fear of the undead will reach debilitating heights. You’ll wish to avoid them at all costs.
Necromancy: Skill in this lessons the effect, and provides ample opportunity to overcome. You may be compelled to raise everything dead quickly, to make it ‘yours’.
Deprecophobia: You’ll have a particular fear of the vampire, as well as ghosts that linger though curses.

objects.title: Zoophobia
objects.text: Fear of beasts, from hungering wolves and soring dragons, to hopping rabbits and buzzing flies. You may choose if all animals gives you the creeps in general, or just the dangerous ones, or just a kind, or just a one. The more focused the target, the more focused the fear, from discomfort, to mind breaking terror.

addons.text: Animal Communication: They may want to talk to you, but you won’t want to talk back. While rendering this less useful, it will give a new avenue to face and overcome your fears.
Transformation or Insectoid Magic’s: Performing such magic’s will be difficult for you, but knowing what makes animals so terrifying will help your magic be far more frightening to others.
Deprecophobia: You’ll have a particular fear of werewolves, as well as fey magics that may transform you or others.

objects.title: Teratophobia
objects.text: Fear of the monstrous and the malformed. From the beast folk and green-kin who stand and walk like civilised races, yet have savage minds and uncouth ways, to the more unknowable slithering monsters of dark outer worlds, found far below the waters of the Deep Rivers. Any life deemed ‘unnatural’ fits.

objects.title: Daemonophobia
objects.text: Fear of the demons, demon-touched, demonology, and anything associated with the infernal realm. A very rational fear, held by many, but it will make facing them in combat difficult and dealing with them near impossible. Most try to mask their fear with hate. Only some succeed, and not all become better for it.

addons.text: Demon Touched: You’ll have an unavoidable self-loathing for the association, inclined to hide your demonic features wherever possible.

Demonology: Skill in this lessons your fear, and provides ample opportunity to overcome it. Any dealings with demons will take longer as you’ll be far more paranoid, though your knowledge and inclinations will likely centre on the control and banishing side more than the summoning and dealing side anyway.

objects.title: Theophobia
objects.text: Fear of the divine realm, the gods and their servants, as well as their celestially touched progeny. Normal among the sinister, and reasonable among the reasoned, where thoughts of unknowable outside influences is an obvious cause for concern. Extends as well to the various organised religions, as well as cults that worship less divine realms.

addons.text: As the Soporatus Cult worships the path to the trophies, they’ll only illicit a minor occasional shudder.
Celestial Touched: You’ll have a little bit of self-loathing, inclined to hide your celestial features, and you’ll have no interesting is discovering your bloodline, if relevant.

Divine knowledge: While you may never understand the gods, exposure helps. You will not likely be able to work with the entities of the divine realm peaceably, preferring to take power through strength of will, where your dominance is unquestioned.

objects.title: Rhabdophobia
objects.text: Fear of magic in all forms, from enchanted items to summoned spells and the practitioners who wield them. The art of the unnatural is the fear of many mundane warriors, and while most use the fear to learn anti-mage tactics, others vow to run hard in the opposite direction. You’ll prefer reality stay as is.

addons.text: Magic knowledge: Understanding is the first step to overcoming, and your existing knowledge will help. Studying further will be slowed significantly as understanding will be needed before any practice, and experimentation will be impossible with this fear unconquered.

objects.title: Somniphobia
objects.text: Fear of sleep and dreams. In a world born of and tied to dreams and nightmares, where unconsciousness reveals truths more real than the waking world, and all such things are experienced when alone and vulnerable, sleep, and the things encountered within and around it, can hold a unique terror.

addons.text: This can manifest in a desire not to sleep, and an attempt to avoid doing so wherever possible, if sleep is what you fear. Sleep walkers, who move without mind, or sleep related magic’s, or Dormientes, or the powers themselves; anything sleep related can be counted.
No Sleep Needed: Avoiding sleep simply increases your fear of it and the many things associated with it. It will be the great inky darkness that oozes through all the unconscious minds around you.
Sleep Paralysis or Dream Horrors: You may develop this condition anyway in the future, with this just guaranteeing it.
Dreamworld Closer/Access: The denizens of the dreamworld may also be among those sleep related things that trigger your terror, as well as their shifting unnatural demesne.

objects.title: Close Mentalities
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: Dreaded Experiences
rows.titleText:
The future remains an unknown to you, but like a self-sacrificing nature, you can lay the groundwork for catastrophe all the same. Traps upon your future path that will trigger, avoidable only through death and failure.

To not pick these events, as well you shouldn’t, will not keep them from your throat. Chance is a fickle thing that can work with you or turn against you at a moments notice, and all such things may come to pass many times for the long lived unfortunate. Picking them here, though, ensures their arrival, and gives them a gravitas of importance when they do.

objects.title: Bad Influences
objects.text: You’ll make some friends you’ll be better off without, their questionable characters carrying a co-dependent immorality. You won’t recognise this at first meeting, only suspecting when you already rely on them. Their manipulations will drain your finances, reputation, health, and anything else they can get from you.

addons.text: A Friend: Your friend will not be among these bad influences, and may even warn against them, but your bad friends will warn against the good, making it impossible to tell them apart until it’s too late.
A Party: The reliable team you can put together will be the same, though mixed with these unreliable friends, it will be hard to tell the good ones from the bad.

objects.title: Stolen Identity
objects.text: At some point, someone will pretend to be you and use your reputation for their own ends, sullying it in some way. This trickster may do this multiple times until caught, and catching them will not undo the damage caused. It may be for revenge, be part of a plot, or be purely for selfish reasons.

addons.text: Bad Influences: Your ‘friends’, who will grow to know you so well, are likely to be behind this, using your reputation for maximum profit, and causing maximum vindictive harm when their masks come off.

objects.title: Cuckolded
objects.text: Your chosen lover will cheat on you, sharing their favours with another, or several others. This may be a simple betrayal, or it may be more sinister, their attentions coerced through blackmail, threats, violence, or mind control. This will be a betrayal, in fidelity and secrets, and will be damaging to you.

addons.text: While some may not view this as problematic (even the opposite), others likely will. Your reputation will take a hit as there will be a humiliating public component to this.
Bad Influences: Your lover may be part of the group you call friends, or part of the group may be behind their infidelity. Either way, they’re more likely involved.

objects.title: Death of Love
objects.text: It is better to have loved and lost as they say, though it will be bitter comfort to you when fate takes away the warm feelings in your heart. This is guaranteed to cause significant emotional damage to you. If it is death that parts you, it will not be reversible, and if they still live, you cannot rekindle what you had.

addons.text: Cuckolded: Naturally, this cruel infidelity is likely the cause of such irreconcilable differences.

objects.title: Cursed Artefact
objects.text: You will no doubt encounter many items bearing some enchantment, from glittering baubles gifted innocuously, to powerful weapons that can turn any tide. One of these will bear with it a curse that will be very difficult to break, that will rob you of your looks, your abilities, or some part of your mind.

objects.title: Otherworldly Encounter
objects.text: Whether in dreams or reality or the frayed space between, you will encounter something so unreal as to damage your mind. This will likely lead to some permanent unusual behaviour or neurosis, or an obsession with understanding what you encountered, which may harm you more.

addons.text: It will take a strong will to overcome this, or a stronger intelligence to understand it. When seeing the state of people who have escaped the cults of the deep rivers, you may regret taking this.
Blindness: You will be somewhat protected from the mental damage, but will still be effected and terrified by the encounter.

objects.title: A Traumatic Scene
objects.text: There are some things that none would wish to see, as while the beholder may not be the sufferer, the suffering is carried with them all the same. You will see at least one grossly horrific sight: some act of mass ruination that will set your stomach upturned, remaining visible even behind closed eyes.

objects.title: Near Death Experience
objects.text: There will be a time where you get so close to death that it changes you, giving a new fear, cowardice, physical scar, or lingering trauma that you’ll carry with you forever after. While they may fade over the years, you will still wake sweating and screaming from time to time, the edge of death always waiting.

objects.title: An Impossible Trial
objects.text: You will face a challenge that will not be possible, though it will look as though you can do it. Failure will not be the end of your journey, but you may suffer as you tackle it again and again, the solution seemingly just out of reach. Low will, or high wisdom, will help here, as giving up is the only way to go on.

addons.text: It is quite likely this will be a key quest, and there will be a yearlong delay before you can formally give up and take another in the same country.

objects.title: Plan Failing
objects.text: A part of your life or adventure will call for a complex plan, and this plan will fail in the most disastrous way possible. This may lead to the death of an ally, your imprisonment, some grievous injury, or a monumental setback. It will be the kind of failure that lingers in your mind for years after.

addons.text: Bad Influences: Relying on unreliable people may be the cause of the plan going awry. Unexpected betrayal or negligence can put a hole in any plan.

objects.title: Calamitous Setback
objects.text: About half way through your journey, you will find yourself reset by some catastrophe. Your positive reputation will be undone, your items lost, some measure of your progress ruined. Any place you have made for yourself will be overturned and many allies will become enemies. A truly disheartening experience.

addons.text: This will occur approximately at the mid-point of your journey, where a rhythm is found and progress picks up speed. When it appears to be smooth sailing ahead, the setback will occur.

Cursed Artefact: It may be that the levelling of the curse cripples you in form far more than otherwise, robbing you of allies and abilities. You may be changed so much that others assume you dead or unsaveable.
Plan Failing: The failure will lead to the calamity, everything falling apart in a single disastrous gambit. The setback will be more complete, and happen over a very short span of time.

objects.title: Rescue Required
objects.text: At some point, you will require rescue, being trapped in some situation beyond your control or power to resolve. The fewer friends, family, and allies you have, the longer you will suffer waiting, and while you will likely survive, your rescuers may not. It is likely you’ll lose someone you care about (or at least cares about you).

addons.text: If this is part of some master gambit, your allies could have you rescued within the day. In the more likely scenario of it being unexpected, it will be longer, and should you also lack allies, it may be an imprisonment that lasts many years. Your skills and magic will not help you escape, only survive.
Death in Time: Your clock will not stop for this.
Bad Influences: These friends will not help you, and may in fact discourage any attempt to do so.

Calamitous Setback: The setback will likely be the cause of your imprisonment, setting you back further and keeping you there longer. It may also mean you have fewer people able to rescue you, but makes for a great comeback story.

objects.title: Undesirable Sex
objects.text: A sexual experience will befall you that will be negative in all possible ways. It will be with a partner (or partners) that, while matching your sexuality, will be of poor character and appearance, and the act itself will be deeply unpleasant, humiliating, and traumatic. Blackmail, drink, trickery, poison, threats, violence, magic; whatever vulnerability you have will be exploited to make it happen.

addons.text: Bad Influences: It may be your ‘friends’ who pressure you into it, or otherwise trick or take advantage of you, adding to their inevitable betrayal.

objects.title: Extra Unwanted
objects.text: The unwanted sexual experience will now be with or heavily involve someone that does not match your sexual preference at all. Their gender will mismatch your liking, their age be too old or too young, and their race may even repulse you. If you are particularly open minded, they may be of a repulsive species or concept, incompatible with any possible enjoyment.

objects.title: Lengthy Encounter
objects.text: The number of partners will increase, and thus the time the encounter will take will increase as well, stretching over multiple days or sessions or merely caught breaths. You can choose the rough balance of this lengthy fated encounter yourself: anything between fifty people taking one turn, to one person taking fifty turns.

addons.text: The exact numbers will vary based on the situation, along with what a ‘turn’ is; it may be considerably more or less in the end, but either way, it will be too long by your reckoning.
Rescue Required: It is likely, though not guaranteed, that these events will combine. If they do, the length will be linked to your imprisonment, and so may increase greatly.

objects.title: Unaware Beginnings
objects.text: Those responsible and engaged in the unwanted intercourse will do so when you are unawares. This may be when you are sleeping, drugged, or drunk, and for so long as they are not caught, the act will go on until they are satisfied. Waking in the middle may allow you to stop them, while if waking at the end, it will be obvious something happened, though not who did it.

addons.text: They are likely to take their time, the first ‘round’ finishing before you could possibly wake. While this spares you from the experience, repeat offences are possible until the perpetrator is confronted.

Lengthy Encounter: They will use methods that make waking mid-act less likely, and will keep gently assaulting you for as long as they can get away with it, for months, or even years. There will soon be evidence left on your body alerting you that it is happening, but until you can figure out who the various culprits are, it will not end.

Heavy Sleeper: Knowing you will not wake, they will not being gentle as a result. This will leave evidence, and possibly damage, on your body alerting you that it happened, and they will not dare do it again.

Heavy Sleeper and Lengthy Encounter: They will do this every opportunity that they can get away with, knowing you will not wake, and being far from gentle as a result. There will soon be evidence left on your body alerting you that it is happening, but until you can figure out the various culprits, it will not end, continuing almost brazenly.

objects.title: A Costly Requirement
objects.text: At some point, someone you do not like will have something you need, be it information, access, power, freedom, secrecy, reputation, the safety of those you care about, or anything else critical for success. In this moment, when they have power over you, they will use it to make you do something for them that will go against your character, such as:

addons.text: A murder, or threat against someone, or a theft or job or another one off requirement asking you to do something unpleasant, getting your hands dirty over the span of a single night. It would be something you would not do, even if paid in gold, and so the already amoral may face a more physically disgusting job.

A longer job, lasting several nights, or a week at the most. It may be that a lot of small jobs are required in that time or the task is simply greater. Using you, they can take out rivals and increase their power considerably, having muscle for unscrupulous deals, or the transporting of smuggled goods.

Weeks and months may pass meeting the requirements of your provider, in which their personal enrichment will take centre stage. You’ll be doing longer and more difficult jobs for them and it will be harder to hide your illicit involvement. What’s more they’re unlikely to use the power you give them for good, or for your benefit.

You may never be free of them, in debt indefinitely lest their support or service fall away at the worst possible time. Their requirements may not be intense, but you’ll usually get a new task every month on average, and while they’ll likely repeat, they’ll never be pleasant or wholesome. You’re likely to be associated with them more publicly as well, openly or as an open secret.

You are a slave in all but name. The person who holds power over you will use your services often, and while you’ll have time to pursue your own life and goals, you are their employee first and foremost. They may even help you in your quest as if you are strong enough to match their ambition, they may climb as high as a throne.
Calamitous Setback: If you’re lucky, your setback will be caused by this deal ending, freeing you in your fall from the permanence of its snare.

objects.title: A Sexual Requirement
objects.text: In addition to the other unwanted tasks undertaken to get what you need, the requirements of your ‘benefactor’ will be sexual in nature. Their form and character will make it quite unpleasant, leaving you feeling used and dirty as they erode any self-worth you may have. Whether they brag publicly about this will be up to them. Only goes as far as A Costly Requirement.

addons.text: A single erotic experience, usually light, serviced directly upon the shameless owed. A dance, perhaps naked. A kiss, perhaps not on their mouth. A suck, perhaps given, perhaps received. At worst, it will be a tumble in the sheets, satisfying them and disappointing you.

Not content with the perfunctory symbolism of sexual submission, the holder of your debt will require a longer service, likely requiring a long night and a long day in bed together. There, all the acts befitting their stamina may be performed, and as rough or gentle as they may, but no more after that unless given freely.

You’ll effectively need to live with them for a time, being their partner and entertainment, either joining their harem or being the toy of their sole attention. When months have passed, you’ll be free of them, but knowing this, they are unlikely to leave the months uneventful.

Now bound to them long term, they may request you for sexual relief from time to time. What’s more, you may find yourself prostituted, you services shared with others for favours to your benefactor. This will make keeping the secret much harder, and give an average twice monthly humiliation.

Your body and service will belong to them, their home now your home. Whether this takes the form of marriage, your body a near nightly feast for them, or should they view you more as a capable whore, your services shared between many paying customers, will be up to them. You may continue your quest and life, but your time not being manhandled will be limited.
Ugly: They are less attractive than you, and you being so unattractive already, they are truly the bottom of the barrel.

objects.title: Betrayed
objects.text: You will be betrayed by someone you rely on in a fairly grand way, not only putting you in a dangerous or difficult situation, but robbing you of an ally in the process. This can stand alone, or lead to any number of other experiences chosen here, heightening and worsening them, but getting both over and done with as one.

addons.text: Bad Influences: The many small betrayals of your ‘friends’ won’t count, but their ultimate abandoning of you may, and be much worse for it.
Cuckolded: Already a betrayal, infidelity can become vindictive harm, seeking to hurt you as badly as possible and turn friends and family against you in the process.
Cursed Artefact: This may be given to you knowingly by someone who knows your abilities, and thus be more attuned to weaken your strengths or exploit your vulnerabilities.
Plan Failing or Calamitous Setback: These may be cause by betrayal from within, and thus not only will your setback be immense, but your list of allies will grow thinner when you need them most.
Rescue Required: If the cause, your allies may be divided or mislead, and thus any rescue, or even knowledge of your capture, will take much longer to manifest.

objects.title: Betrayer
objects.text: You will betray someone. Perhaps you have no choice, the situation changing drastically after your promise is made. Perhaps it is a gambit to undo an enemy, or perhaps a worthy sacrifice on your journey. It will break the person, and mark you as an oath breaker, drastically reducing peoples trust in you, and may have consequences among gods and demons.

addons.text: Contract Abidance: This will hit you with the maximum punishment, putting you in the power of someone who will have every right to hate you.

objects.title: Close Experiences
objects.text: Return to the choice of banes.

rows.title: The skin is marked, the soul is twisted…
rows.titleText:
With all the burdens you wish to carry now loaded onto your back, what is there left to do but go on?

You take one last look, one pause, one warm soak in the endless possibilities of dream, before you have to wake and become real.

objects.title: Now You’re Ready to Go
objects.text: Select this to unlock the final option of The World In Sight, your new reality now frighteningly close.

objects.title: Close Banes
objects.text: Return to the world in sight.

rows.title: The Regard of your Journey
rows.titleText:
It is ultimately up to others if you will be a hero, or a villain. A stalwart citizen or a slinking wretch. The reputation you have acquired before even your arrival may be a lingering stigma or a starred cloak of assumed riotousness. On a long enough journey, all secrets are known, and you allies and enemies may change dependent on what people will think power will do to you, and you for them.

In your future, closer now than ever before, you see a path of…

objects.title: Villainy
objects.text: Your actions will be assumed malignant, your demeanour radiating a debauched, evil, and criminal intent. The established law of the land that you should otherwise adhere to will strike you first, and so the criminal, the rebel, and the rejected may flock to your banner, eager to lash back at their oppressors. Forced to a hard path, but a free path.

objects.title: Wretchedness
objects.text: Your demeanour will be unwelcome, civility demanding your exclusion, yet you can rise above. Such is the champion of the downtrodden: the underdog, upturning established rules and uprooting deep prejudice. A path of begrudging respect, but one beset by the assumption of your failure, and the harsh judgement of others should you meet their expectations.

objects.title: Adventure
objects.text: You will be as welcome as any other in the land of keys and adventurers as yours is a path trodden many times before and is both benign and remarkable. Others won’t know what to make of you in the moment; the allies you make may colour others opinions of you more than anything you do. Your deeds will be of note and tales will be told of your exploits over your motivations.

objects.title: Heroism
objects.text: Yours will be the stature of the good, where song and cheer and patted backs will accompany you from the common folk. Nobles and kings will seek to endorse you, linking their worth to yours, just as the cruel and uncanny will plot for your fall, fearful of your noble reputation turning against them. A path of high expectations, met only by the good.

objects.title: Divinity
objects.text: Yours will be a radiance others will flock to, your goodness an assumed and obvious reality to your observers. Straying from their assumptions will break hearts as all who wish to lay claim to righteousness will call your friend. Evil will flee and cower, lashing out long before you see it, and statues will be erected in your lifetime, your high worth bringing high scrutiny.

rows.title: The End is Only the Beginning
rows.titleText:
And just like that, the dream is over. It is not your own bed you wake in though, nor even your old side of existence. Through a swirling maelstrom of setting thoughts -the world changed; the world having always been the same- you spy the dizzying rush of a new reality racing toward you, fast, your new and coalescing heart beating in your virgin throat. Too fast. You’re falling!

It is with a strange and bitter twang you realise that of course you are. Falling always wakes you. 

Clouds pass and horizons shrink. Places seen and changed tease you as they shift below. People unmet busy themselves as teeming dots, their lives soon to become tangled in your own. It’s calming, in a way, though, as the great dream tower looms large on the horizon and begins to tower over you, its peak passed, blotting out a rising sun you have never before seen, you realise the falseness of the calm and your own dire mistake. Falling doesn’t wake you. I never has. The only part of it that did…

…is the landing. 




The adventure begins!

objects.title: Art Credits
objects.text:
You can download a full and extensive list of credits for all art used in this CYOA, as well as links to the artists pages. Use the link below:

https://sleepersdream.neocities.org/SDI/Art%20Credit%20List%20for%20Sleepers%20Dream.txt 

I hope this CYOA has gone to show that real art gives a quality and inspiration that should be appreciated and encouraged as much as possible.

objects.title: Creator Credit
objects.text:
I was the one who stole all this art and wrote stuff underneath it. If you want me to do it again, I have a donation page. You can find it using the link below:

https://www.buymeacoffee.com/TheOneThatWonders

This is still a work in progress if you can believe it; I plan on expanding it quite a bit. Every little helps in getting that done.

objects.title: You Credit
objects.text:
Thanks for reading through this CYOA; I hope you enjoyed it. If you see anything wrong with it, like spelling being wrong, or options not working, or even bad grammar not being good grammar done right, let me know and I’ll get it fixed. Trust me, it bugs me more than it does you. 

Remember to encourage your local CYOA creators, and keep being awesome.
